-// ── c007: tend_create_feature input schema declares journey_phase / personas / solves ─
-//
-// These three fields were missing from the registerTool inputSchema, so the
-// MCP SDK's zod parser was silently stripping them from agent calls. Agents
-// would pass journey_phase/personas/solves in a single create call; the fields
-// were not present in the validated args object and therefore never written to
-// the polyglot. The fix: declare all three fields in the inputSchema.
-//
-// Source-code content test: the mock server used in tools.test.ts bypasses zod
-// schema validation (calls handler directly), so the mock tests pass even when
-// the fields are missing from the schema. The only way to pin this invariant is
-// to read the registration source directly.
-//
-// negctrl: remove z.array(z.string()) for personas from features.ts
-//   → test must fail → DISCRIMINATES.
-describe('c007 — tend_create_feature inputSchema declares journey_phase, personas, solves', () => {
-  const src = readSrc('src/mcp/tools/features.ts');
-  // Grab just the tend_create_feature registration block (up to the next tool).
-  const createBlock = src.slice(
-    src.indexOf("server.registerTool('tend_create_feature'"),
-    src.indexOf("server.registerTool('tend_update_feature'"),
-  );
-
-  it('declares journey_phase in inputSchema', () => {
-    expect(createBlock).toContain('journey_phase');
-  });
-
-  it('declares personas in inputSchema', () => {
-    expect(createBlock).toContain('personas');
-  });
-
-  it('declares solves in inputSchema', () => {
-    expect(createBlock).toContain('solves');
-  });
-});
-
-// ── c006: tend_output_execution_plan description uses real FeatureStatus values ─
-//
-// The real FeatureStatus union is `planned | in-progress | verified`. The statuses
-// 'implemented' and 'published' do not exist. The approval gate is:
-//   APPROVED_ONLY = {planned, in-progress}  (default, without force)
-//   FORCE_ALLOWED = {planned, in-progress, verified}  (with force=true)
-//
-// Source-code content test: we read the tool registration source directly,
-// because the mock-server harness used in output-execution-plan.test.ts discards
-// the schema argument to registerTool and so never exposes the description string.
-// Asserting the source file is the only practicable way to pin this invariant.
-//
-// negctrl: insert 'implemented' into the description in output-execution-plan.ts
-//   → test must fail → DISCRIMINATES.
-describe('c006 — tend_output_execution_plan description references valid FeatureStatus values only', () => {
-  const src = readSrc('src/mcp/tools/output-execution-plan.ts');
-
-  it('description does not mention non-existent status "implemented"', () => {
-    expect(src).not.toContain('implemented');
-  });
-
-  it('description does not mention non-existent status "published"', () => {
-    expect(src).not.toContain('published');
-  });
-
-  it('force param description mentions "verified" (the real FORCE_ALLOWED addition)', () => {
-    expect(src).toContain('verified');
-  });
-});

-/**
- * Integration test for runAggregate's catalog-description recovery path.
- *
- * `tend aggregate` must materialize any persona / opportunity polyglot that
- * exists in the catalog but has no file on disk yet — the state a hand-edited
- * or imported catalog (or a pre-scaffold tend version) leaves behind. This
- * mirrors the tend_update_catalog side-effect so aggregate can rebuild a
- * project to consistency.
- */
-
-import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach, afterEach } from 'vitest';
-import { mkdtemp, mkdir, rm } from 'node:fs/promises';
-import { existsSync } from 'node:fs';
-import { tmpdir } from 'node:os';
-import { join } from 'node:path';
-import { runAggregate } from './aggregate.js';
-import { writeCatalog, readCatalog, readFeature } from '../../core/files.js';
-import type { Catalog } from '../../core/types.js';
-
-describe('runAggregate — catalog-description polyglot recovery', () => {
-  let tmp: string;
-
-  beforeEach(async () => {
-    tmp = await mkdtemp(join(tmpdir(), 'tend-aggregate-recovery-'));
-    await mkdir(join(tmp, 'docs', 'tend', 'features'), { recursive: true });
-  });
-
-  afterEach(async () => {
-    await rm(tmp, { recursive: true, force: true });
-  });
-
-  it('materializes missing catalog-description polyglots from approved catalog entries; skips drafts', async () => {
-    // writeCatalog assembles the garden polyglot but does NOT scaffold the
-    // persona / opportunity polyglots — exactly the inconsistent on-disk state.
-    const catalog: Catalog = {
-      schema_version: '1',
-      project_id: 'test',
-      status: 'draft',
-      features: [],
-      personas: [
-        { id: 'brand-operator', name: 'Brand Operator', archetype: 'Owns the brand.', jobs: ['When …'] },
-        { id: 'draft-persona', name: 'Draft Persona', status: 'draft' },
-      ],
-      opportunities: [
-        { id: 'agent-off-brand', description: 'Off-brand UI ships.', value: 'critical' },
-      ],
-    };
-    await writeCatalog(catalog, tmp);
-
-    const path = (id: string) => join(tmp, 'docs', 'tend', 'features', `${id}.tend.html`);
-    expect(existsSync(path('brand-operator'))).toBe(false);
-    expect(existsSync(path('agent-off-brand'))).toBe(false);
-
-    await runAggregate(tmp);
-
-    // Approved entries are recovered with their snapshot.
-    expect(existsSync(path('brand-operator'))).toBe(true);
-    expect(existsSync(path('agent-off-brand'))).toBe(true);
-    const persona = await readFeature('brand-operator', tmp);
-    expect(persona.persona?.archetype).toBe('Owns the brand.');
-    const opp = await readFeature('agent-off-brand', tmp);
-    expect(opp.opportunity?.value).toBe('critical');
-
-    // The draft entry is NOT scaffolded (waits for approval).
-    expect(existsSync(path('draft-persona'))).toBe(false);
-  });
-});

-/**
- * Tests for the tend_get_next MCP tool.
- *
- * Verifies registration, return shape, and parity with the underlying
- * `computeNextAction` core function.
- */
-
-import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach, afterEach, vi } from 'vitest';
-import { mkdtemp, mkdir, rm } from 'node:fs/promises';
-import { tmpdir } from 'node:os';
-import { join } from 'node:path';
-import { writeFeature, writeCatalog } from '../../core/files.js';
-import { computeNextAction } from '../../core/next-action.js';
-import type { Catalog, Feature } from '../../core/types.js';
-
-// ─── Mock McpServer ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-
-type ToolResult = {
-  content: Array<{ type: 'text'; text: string }>;
-  isError?: true;
-};
-type ToolHandler = (args: Record<string, unknown>) => Promise<ToolResult>;
-
-function createMockServer() {
-  const handlers = new Map<string, ToolHandler>();
-  return {
-    registerTool(name: string, _schema: unknown, handler: ToolHandler) {
-      handlers.set(name, handler);
-    },
-    async call(name: string, args: Record<string, unknown> = {}): Promise<ToolResult> {
-      const handler = handlers.get(name);
-      if (!handler) throw new Error(`Tool "${name}" not registered`);
-      return handler(args);
-    },
-    registeredNames(): string[] {
-      return Array.from(handlers.keys());
-    },
-  };
-}
-
-function parse(result: ToolResult): unknown {
-  return JSON.parse(result.content[0]!.text);
-}
-
-// ─── Fixtures ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-
-function makeCatalog(overrides: Partial<Catalog> = {}): Catalog {
-  return {
-    schema_version: '1',
-    project_id: 'test',
-    status: 'draft',
-    features: [],
-    ...overrides,
-  };
-}
-
-function makeFeature(id: string, overrides: Partial<Feature> = {}): Feature {
-  return {
-    id,
-    title: id,
-    status: 'planned',
-    ...overrides,
-  };
-}
-
-async function writeProject(
-  tmp: string,
-  catalog: Catalog,
-  features: Feature[],
-): Promise<void> {
-  await mkdir(join(tmp, 'docs', 'tend', 'features'), { recursive: true });
-  await writeCatalog(catalog, tmp);
-  for (const f of features) {
-    await writeFeature(f, tmp);
-  }
-}
-
-// ─── Tests ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-
-describe('tend_get_next MCP tool', () => {
-  let tmp: string;
-  let server: ReturnType<typeof createMockServer>;
-
-  beforeEach(async () => {
-    tmp = await mkdtemp(join(tmpdir(), 'tend-mcp-next-'));
-    await mkdir(join(tmp, 'docs', 'tend', 'features'), { recursive: true });
-    vi.spyOn(process, 'cwd').mockReturnValue(tmp);
-    server = createMockServer();
-    const { registerNextActionTools } = await import('./next-action.js');
-    registerNextActionTools(server as never);
-  });
-
-  afterEach(async () => {
-    vi.restoreAllMocks();
-    await rm(tmp, { recursive: true, force: true });
-  });
-
-  it('registers the tend_get_next tool', () => {
-    expect(server.registeredNames()).toContain('tend_get_next');
-  });
-
-  it('returns a NextAction-shaped result', async () => {
-    const features: Feature[] = [
-      makeFeature('feat-a', {
-        status: 'in-progress',
-        progress: { implementation: 100, verification: 50 },
-      }),
-    ];
-    const catalog = makeCatalog({
-      features: features.map((f) => ({ id: f.id, title: f.id, status: f.status })),
-    });
-    await writeProject(tmp, catalog, features);
-
-    const result = await server.call('tend_get_next');
-    const parsed = parse(result) as Record<string, unknown>;
-
-    expect(typeof parsed['action']).toBe('string');
-    expect(Array.isArray(parsed['reason_codes'])).toBe(true);
-    expect((parsed['reason_codes'] as unknown[]).length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);
-    expect(typeof parsed['explanation']).toBe('string');
-    expect(Array.isArray(parsed['not_chosen'])).toBe(true);
-  });
-
-  it('returns the same result as direct computeNextAction()', async () => {
-    const features: Feature[] = [
-      makeFeature('feat-a', { status: 'planned', priority: 'high' }),
-      makeFeature('feat-b', { status: 'planned', dependencies: ['feat-a'] }),
-    ];
-    const catalog = makeCatalog({
-      features: features.map((f) => ({ id: f.id, title: f.id, status: f.status })),
-    });
-    await writeProject(tmp, catalog, features);
-
-    const direct = await computeNextAction(tmp);
-    const viaTool = parse(await server.call('tend_get_next'));
-    expect(viaTool).toEqual(direct);
-  });
-});

-/**

- * Strategy: write adapter JSON configs pointing at absolute dist/ generator

- * package link. Polyglot fixtures use the same minimal oo-data block pattern
- * as tools.test.ts.

-
-import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach, afterEach, vi } from 'vitest';
-import { mkdtemp, mkdir, rm, readFile, writeFile, access } from 'node:fs/promises';
-import { tmpdir } from 'node:os';

-// ─── Mock server (same pattern as tools.test.ts) ─────────────────────────────
-
-type ToolResult = {
-  content: Array<{ type: 'text'; text: string }>;
-  isError?: true;
-};
-type ToolHandler = (args: Record<string, unknown>) => Promise<ToolResult>;
-
-function createMockServer() {
-  const handlers = new Map<string, ToolHandler>();
-  return {
-    registerTool(name: string, _schema: unknown, handler: ToolHandler) {
-      handlers.set(name, handler);
-    },
-    async call(name: string, args: Record<string, unknown> = {}): Promise<ToolResult> {
-      const handler = handlers.get(name);
-      if (!handler) throw new Error(`Tool "${name}" not registered`);
-      return handler(args);
-    },
-  };
-}
-
-function parse(result: ToolResult): any {
-  return JSON.parse(result.content[0]!.text);
-}
-
-function errText(result: ToolResult): string {
-  return result.content[0]!.text;

-// ─── Fixtures ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-
-/**
- * Absolute paths to the compiled generator dist files.
- * These are always available since `npm run build` has run — the dist/ files
- * are checked into the repo / built as part of CI. Using absolute paths lets
- * loadGenerator() import() them without a self-referential package link.
- */
-const ROOT = resolve(import.meta.url.replace('file://', ''), '../../../..');
-const DIST_GENERATORS: Record<string, string> = {
-  'claude-tasks': join(ROOT, 'dist/adapters/claude-tasks/generator.js'),
-  markdown: join(ROOT, 'dist/adapters/markdown/generator.js'),
-  'github-issues': join(ROOT, 'dist/adapters/github-issues/generator.js'),
-  makefile: join(ROOT, 'dist/adapters/makefile/generator.js'),
-};

-function makeCatalog(overrides: Partial<Catalog> = {}): Catalog {
-  return {
-    schema_version: '1',
-    project_id: 'test-project',
-    status: 'draft',
-    features: [],
-    ...overrides,
-  };
-}
-
-function makeFeature(overrides: Partial<Feature> = {}): Feature {

-    id: 'feat',
-    title: 'Feature',
-    status: 'planned',
-    ...overrides,
-  };
-}
-
-function makeStep(id: string, title: string = `Step ${id}`) {
-  return { id, title, status: 'pending' as const };
-}
-
-let tmp: string;
-let server: ReturnType<typeof createMockServer>;
-
-async function makeTendDirs(): Promise<void> {
-  await mkdir(join(tmp, 'docs', 'tend', 'features'), { recursive: true });
-  await mkdir(join(tmp, 'docs', 'tend', 'adapters'), { recursive: true });
-}
-
-async function writeCatalogFile(catalog: Catalog): Promise<void> {
-  await writeJSON(join(tmp, 'docs', 'tend', 'catalog.json'), catalog);
-}
-
-async function writeFeatureFile(feature: Feature): Promise<void> {
-  const path = join(tmp, 'docs', 'tend', 'features', `${feature.id}.tend.html`);
-  const json = JSON.stringify(feature, null, 2).replace(/<\/script/g, '<\\/script');
-  const text =
-    '<!doctype html>\n<html><body>\n' +
-    '<script id="oo-data" type="application/json">\n' +
-    json +
-    '\n</script>\n</body></html>\n';
-  await writeFile(path, text, 'utf8');
-}
-
-/**
- * Write an adapter config JSON pointing at the absolute dist generator path.
- * This is valid adapter config — just has a pre-resolved absolute generator path
- * instead of the package-name bare specifier.
- */
-async function writeAdapterConfig(name: string, generatorPath: string = DIST_GENERATORS[name]!): Promise<void> {
-  const config: AdapterConfig = {
-    adapter_id: name,
-    name: `${name} adapter`,
-    target: name,
-    generator: generatorPath,
-    step_type_support: ['agent', 'command'],
-    model_support: [],
-    status_sync: { mode: 'manual' },
-  };
-  await writeJSON(join(tmp, 'docs', 'tend', 'adapters', `${name}.json`), config);
-}
-
-async function fileExists(path: string): Promise<boolean> {
-  try {
-    await access(path);
-    return true;
-  } catch {
-    return false;
-  }
-}
-
-async function importAndRegister(s: ReturnType<typeof createMockServer>): Promise<void> {
-  const { registerAllTools } = await import('./index.js');
-  registerAllTools(s as never);
-}
-
-beforeEach(async () => {
-  tmp = await mkdtemp(join(tmpdir(), 'tend-oep-test-'));
-  await makeTendDirs();
-  vi.spyOn(process, 'cwd').mockReturnValue(tmp);

-// ─── Feature with steps helper ───────────────────────────────────────────────

-async function setupFeatureWithSteps(

-  status: Feature['status'] = 'planned',

-/**
- * Integration tests for the MCP tool surface.

- *
- *   Writes:        tend_create_feature, tend_update_feature, tend_delete_feature,
- *                  tend_update_catalog
- *   Discovery:     tend_get_gaps, tend_get_unblocked, tend_get_context
- *   Validation:    tend_validate (constraints.ts folded in)
- *   Project ops:   tend_aggregate, tend_output_execution_plan
- *
- * Tests verify auto-side-effects: schema validation, blast-radius refusals,
- * audit auto-invalidation, progress recompute, atomic writes.
- */
-
-import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach, afterEach, vi } from 'vitest';
-import { mkdtemp, mkdir, rm, readFile, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises';

-// ─── Mock McpServer ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-
-type ToolResult = {
-  content: Array<{ type: 'text'; text: string }>;
-  isError?: true;
-};
-type ToolHandler = (args: Record<string, unknown>) => Promise<ToolResult>;
-
-function createMockServer() {
-  const handlers = new Map<string, ToolHandler>();
-  const schemas = new Map<string, { description?: string; inputSchema?: Record<string, unknown> }>();
-  return {
-    registerTool(
-      name: string,
-      schema: { description?: string; inputSchema?: Record<string, unknown> },
-      handler: ToolHandler,
-    ) {
-      handlers.set(name, handler);
-      schemas.set(name, schema);
-    },
-    async call(name: string, args: Record<string, unknown> = {}): Promise<ToolResult> {
-      const handler = handlers.get(name);
-      if (!handler) throw new Error(`Tool "${name}" not registered`);
-      return handler(args);
-    },
-    // The declared input parameter names for a tool. A real MCP client/server strips
-    // params not in inputSchema, so a field the tool means to accept MUST be declared
-    // here or it is silently dropped before the handler runs.
-    declaredParams(name: string): string[] {
-      return Object.keys(schemas.get(name)?.inputSchema ?? {});
-    },
-    registeredNames(): string[] {
-      return Array.from(handlers.keys());
-    },
-  };
-}
-
-function parse(result: ToolResult): any {
-  return JSON.parse(result.content[0]!.text);
-}
-
-function errText(result: ToolResult): string {
-  return result.content[0]!.text;
-}
-

-async function writeCatalogFile(catalog: Catalog): Promise<void> {

-    '<script id="oo-data" type="application/json">\n' +

-    '\n</script>\n</body></html>\n';

-  it('sorts by severity high→medium→low across three distinct levels', async () => {
-    // Fixture is designed so that WITHOUT the sort, gaps arrive in the wrong order:
-    //   aaa-me is read first (alpha-earlier) and emits only medium gaps.
-    //   zzz-hi is read second and emits high gaps.
-    //   catalog persona with status:'draft' emits a low gap last.
-    // The sort must reorder medium-before-high into high-before-medium.
-    await writeCatalogFile(makeCatalog({
-      personas: [{ id: 'p-draft', name: 'Draft', status: 'draft' }],  // status:'draft' → low gap
-      features: [
-        { id: 'aaa-me', title: 'Medium', status: 'planned' },
-        { id: 'zzz-hi', title: 'High',   status: 'planned' },
-      ],
-    }));
-    // aaa-me: has what+why+checks, missing impact → empty_slot_impact (medium only).
-    // Processed first by readdir (alpha order) — produces medium gaps before high.
-    await writeFeatureFile(makeFeature({
-      id: 'aaa-me',
-      title: 'Medium',
-      what: 'something',
-      why: 'because',
-      checks: [{ id: 'c1', description: 'c1', validates: 'what' }],
-    }));
-    // zzz-hi: no what/why → empty_slot_what (high) + no_checks (high).
-    // Processed second — produces high gaps after medium without the sort.
-    await writeFeatureFile(makeFeature({ id: 'zzz-hi', title: 'High' }));
-
-    const result = await server.call('tend_get_gaps');
-    const data = parse(result);
-    const severities: string[] = data.gaps.map((g: any) => g.severity);
-
-    // Find the first occurrence of each level — high must precede medium, medium precedes low.
-    const firstHigh   = severities.indexOf('high');
-    const firstMedium = severities.indexOf('medium');
-    const firstLow    = severities.indexOf('low');
-
-    expect(firstHigh).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(0);   // high gaps present
-    expect(firstMedium).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(0); // medium gaps present
-    expect(firstLow).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(0);    // low gaps present
-    // Ordering invariant: high < medium < low (by index of first appearance).
-    // Without the sort, aaa-me’s medium gaps would precede zzz-hi’s high gaps.
-    expect(firstHigh).toBeLessThan(firstMedium);
-    expect(firstMedium).toBeLessThan(firstLow);
-  });
-

-// Write serialization — concurrent garden updates
-// ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
-
-describe('write serialization (in-process queue)', () => {
-  it('N concurrent tend_update_feature calls all land in the shared garden aggregate', async () => {
-    // The garden polyglot (overview.html) is shared: every feature update does a
-    // read-modify-write on its features_aggregate. Without serialization the
-    // concurrent updates read the same garden snapshot and the last writer
-    // clobbers the others (lost update). serializeWrite must make every rename
-    // survive in the aggregate.
-    const ids = ['race-a', 'race-b', 'race-c', 'race-d', 'race-e'];
-    await writeCatalogFile(
-      makeCatalog({
-        features: ids.map((id) => ({ id, title: id, status: 'planned' })) as Catalog['features'],
-      }),
-    );
-    for (const id of ids) {
-      await writeFeatureFile(makeFeature({ id, title: id, status: 'planned' }));
-    }
-
-    // Fire every update concurrently — each renames its own feature.
-    const results = await Promise.all(
-      ids.map((id) =>
-        server.call('tend_update_feature', { id, changes: { title: `${id}-renamed` } }),
-      ),
-    );
-    for (const r of results) expect(r.isError).toBeUndefined();
-
-    // Every rename must survive in the garden's features_aggregate — none lost.
-    const catalog = await readCatalogFile();
-    const titles = Object.fromEntries(catalog.features.map((f) => [f.id, f.title]));
-    expect(titles).toEqual({
-      'race-a': 'race-a-renamed',
-      'race-b': 'race-b-renamed',
-      'race-c': 'race-c-renamed',
-      'race-d': 'race-d-renamed',
-      'race-e': 'race-e-renamed',
-    });
-  });
-});

-    // Seed the garden with a health_snapshot that has a known past timestamp

-    await writeGardenPolyglotFile({

-      catalog: { phases: [], personas: [], opportunities: [] },

-      health_snapshot: {

-        truth: { total: 0, verified: 0, stale: 0, mock_only: 0, false_done: 0, auditable: 0, audited: 0 },
-        flow: { ready_now: 0, blocked: 0, bottleneck: null },
-        value: { score: 0, breakdown: [] },
-        computed_at: pastTimestamp,
-      },
-    });
-
-    // Create a new feature through the full MCP handler — refreshHealthSnapshot
-    // must fire as a side-effect inside tend_create_feature itself.

-    // Read the garden polyglot DIRECTLY from disk — no MCP call.

-    const snap = gardenData['health_snapshot'] as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
-
-    // The snapshot must have been written by the MCP side-effect.

-    // computed_at must be NEWER than the seed (MCP fired refreshHealthSnapshot).

-    // truth.total must reflect the new feature (was 0, now ≥ 1).

-    expect(truth['total'] as number).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);

-/**
- * REAL integration tests for runValidate() — no mocks of the validation
- * internals.
- *
- * Each test builds a real tend project on disk (a garden `overview.html` plus
- * feature polyglots under `docs/tend/features/`) seeded with one known defect,
- * then calls the REAL `runValidate(tmpDir)` and asserts the real error /
- * warning / drift_verdict it produces. `scanAllFeaturesStrict`, `readCatalog`,
- * `findStaleVerdicts`, `computeCoverageReport`, `allViolations`, and the
- * narrative/mock detectors all run for real against the temp tree.
- *
- * This is the integration evidence for the mcp-server.validation feature's
- * checks c001–c009. The mock-based unit tests in validation.test.ts pin the
- * path-detection prose filter and the summarizeDrift priority ladder; they do
- * NOT exercise the cross-ref passes against a real project. This file does.
- *
- * @vitest-environment node
- */
-
-import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach, afterEach } from 'vitest';
-import { mkdtemp, mkdir, rm, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
-import { tmpdir } from 'node:os';
-import { join } from 'node:path';
-import { runValidate } from './validation.js';
-import type { Catalog, Feature } from '../../core/types.js';
-
-// ─── Real temp-project fixtures ────────────────────────────────────────────────
-//
-// runValidate(cwd) reads <cwd>/docs/tend/overview.html (garden) and
-// <cwd>/docs/tend/features/*.tend.html. These helpers write that exact layout
-// as real polyglot files whose oo-data block parses — the same shape
-// scanAllFeaturesStrict extracts in production.
-
-let tmp: string;
-
-async function makeTendDirs(root: string): Promise<void> {
-  await mkdir(join(root, 'docs', 'tend', 'features'), { recursive: true });
-}
-
-/** Serialize an object into a minimal polyglot whose oo-data block parses. */
-function polyglot(data: object, meta = '{"kind":"feature","template_version":"1"}'): string {
-  const json = JSON.stringify(data, null, 2).replace(/<\/script/g, '<\\/script');
-  return (
-    '<!doctype html>\n<html><body>\n' +
-    `<script id="oo-meta" type="application/json">\n${meta}\n</script>\n` +
-    '<script id="oo-data" type="application/json">\n' +
-    json +
-    '\n</script>\n</body></html>\n'
-  );
-}
-
-/** Write the garden polyglot. Splits the catalog into catalog + features_aggregate. */
-async function writeGarden(catalog: Partial<Catalog> = {}): Promise<void> {
-  const { features = [], source_dirs, ...catalogBlock } = catalog;
-  const data: Record<string, unknown> = {
-    id: 'garden',
-    title: 'Test Garden',
-    status: 'planned',
-    catalog: { schema_version: '1', project_id: 'test', status: 'draft', ...catalogBlock },
-    features_aggregate: features,
-  };
-  // source_dirs is a TOP-LEVEL garden config field (sibling to catalog), not a catalog entry.
-  if (source_dirs !== undefined) data.source_dirs = source_dirs;
-  await writeFile(
-    join(tmp, 'docs', 'tend', 'overview.html'),
-    polyglot(data, '{"kind":"garden","template_version":"1"}'),
-    'utf8',
-  );
-}
-
-/** Write a feature polyglot under docs/tend/features/<id>.tend.html. */
-async function writeFeature(feature: Partial<Feature> & { id: string }): Promise<void> {
-  const full: Feature = { title: feature.id, status: 'planned', ...feature } as Feature;
-  await writeFile(
-    join(tmp, 'docs', 'tend', 'features', `${feature.id}.tend.html`),
-    polyglot(full),
-    'utf8',
-  );
-}
-
-/** Write an arbitrary raw file under the temp repo root (e.g. a source file). */
-async function writeRepoFile(relPath: string, content: string): Promise<void> {
-  const abs = join(tmp, relPath);
-  await mkdir(join(abs, '..'), { recursive: true });
-  await writeFile(abs, content, 'utf8');
-}
-
-beforeEach(async () => {
-  tmp = await mkdtemp(join(tmpdir(), 'tend-validate-int-'));
-  await makeTendDirs(tmp);
-});
-
-afterEach(async () => {
-  await rm(tmp, { recursive: true, force: true });
-});

-describe('dek_stale — editorial standfirst drifted from the six slots (advisory)', () => {
-  // Write a feature polyglot with a custom oo-meta carrying a dek_sha that no
-  // longer matches the current slot text. runValidate recomputes the slot hash
-  // and emits an advisory dek_stale warning (never gating).
-  async function writeFeatureWithMeta(
-    feature: Partial<Feature> & { id: string },
-    meta: object,
-  ): Promise<void> {
-    const full: Feature = { title: feature.id, status: 'planned', ...feature } as Feature;
-    const json = JSON.stringify(full, null, 2).replace(/<\/script/g, '<\\/script');
-    const metaJson = JSON.stringify(meta).replace(/<\/script/g, '<\\/script');
-    const text =
-      '<!doctype html>\n<html><body>\n' +

diff --git a/src/ui/components/CopyButton.test.tsx b/src/ui/components/CopyButton.test.tsx
deleted file mode 100644
index 1b30ffe..0000000
--- a/src/ui/components/CopyButton.test.tsx
+++ /dev/null
@@ -1,130 +0,0 @@
-/**
- * @vitest-environment jsdom
- *
- * Tests for CopyButton.tsx — the click-to-copy component.
- *
- * Strategy: mount CopyButton with createRoot + act (same pattern as
- * useKeyboardNavigation.test.ts). renderToStaticMarkup is NOT used here
- * because it skips onClick handlers. We need a real DOM click to exercise
- * navigator.clipboard.writeText.
- */
-
-import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach, vi } from 'vitest';
-import { createElement } from 'react';
-import { CopyButton } from './CopyButton.js';
-
-// Enable act() support — silences "current testing environment is not
-// configured to support act(...)" warnings.
-(globalThis as Record<string, unknown>)['IS_REACT_ACT_ENVIRONMENT'] = true;
-
-// ── Helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-
-/**
- * Mount CopyButton in the DOM, click the button, then unmount.
- * Returns the button element reference captured before the click so
- * assertions can inspect initial render state if needed.
- */
-async function mountAndClick(text: string, label?: string): Promise<void> {
-  const { createRoot } = await import('react-dom/client');
-  const { act } = await import('react');
-
-  const container = document.createElement('div');
-  document.body.appendChild(container);
-  const root = createRoot(container);
-
-  await act(async () => {
-    root.render(createElement(CopyButton, { text, label }));
-  });
-
-  // Fire a real click on the rendered button — triggers the onClick handler
-  // which calls navigator.clipboard.writeText.
-  const button = container.querySelector('button');
-  if (!button) throw new Error('CopyButton did not render a <button> element');
-
-  await act(async () => {
-    button.click();
-  });
-
-  await act(async () => {
-    root.unmount();
-  });
-  container.remove();
-}
-
-// ── Tests ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-
-describe('CopyButton — click-to-copy', () => {
-  beforeEach(() => {
-    document.body.innerHTML = '';
-
-    // Stub navigator.clipboard.writeText — jsdom does not implement it.
-    // We need a resolved promise so the async handler doesn't throw.
-    Object.defineProperty(navigator, 'clipboard', {
-      value: { writeText: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(undefined) },
-      writable: true,
-      configurable: true,
-    });
-  });
-
-  it('calls navigator.clipboard.writeText with the supplied text on click', async () => {
-    const writeText = navigator.clipboard.writeText as ReturnType<typeof vi.fn>;
-    await mountAndClick('mcp-server');
-    expect(writeText).toHaveBeenCalledOnce();
-    expect(writeText).toHaveBeenCalledWith('mcp-server');
-  });
-
-  it('calls writeText with the correct text when label is also provided', async () => {
-    const writeText = navigator.clipboard.writeText as ReturnType<typeof vi.fn>;
-    await mountAndClick('web-ui', 'Web UI feature id');
-    expect(writeText).toHaveBeenCalledOnce();
-    expect(writeText).toHaveBeenCalledWith('web-ui');
-  });
-
-  it('does not call writeText when the button is not clicked', async () => {
-    const { createRoot } = await import('react-dom/client');
-    const { act } = await import('react');
-    const writeText = navigator.clipboard.writeText as ReturnType<typeof vi.fn>;
-
-    const container = document.createElement('div');
-    document.body.appendChild(container);
-    const root = createRoot(container);
-
-    await act(async () => {
-      root.render(createElement(CopyButton, { text: 'some-id' }));
-    });
-
-    expect(writeText).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
-
-    await act(async () => { root.unmount(); });
-    container.remove();
-  });
-
-  it('renders the copy glyph before click and switch to check mark after click', async () => {
-    const { createRoot } = await import('react-dom/client');
-    const { act } = await import('react');
-
-    const container = document.createElement('div');
-    document.body.appendChild(container);
-    const root = createRoot(container);
-
-    await act(async () => {
-      root.render(createElement(CopyButton, { text: 'feature-x' }));
-    });
-
-    const button = container.querySelector('button');
-    if (!button) throw new Error('CopyButton did not render a <button> element');
-
-    // Before click — copy glyph
-    expect(button.textContent).toBe('⧉');
-
-    await act(async () => {
-      button.click();
-    });
-
-    // After click — check mark (copied state)
-    expect(button.textContent).toBe('✓');
-
-    await act(async () => { root.unmount(); });
-    container.remove();
-  });
-});

--- a/src/ui/components/FeatureEdge.test.tsx
+++ /dev/null
@@ -1,78 +0,0 @@
-/**
- * @vitest-environment jsdom
- *
- * Tests for FeatureEdge — the React Flow edge renderer that distinguishes
- * dependency / enables / hierarchy edges by dash pattern and CSS class.
- */
-
-import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
-import { renderToStaticMarkup } from 'react-dom/server';
-import { ReactFlowProvider, Position } from '@xyflow/react';
-import { FeatureEdge } from './FeatureEdge.js';
-
-type EdgeKind = 'dependency' | 'enables' | 'hierarchy';
-
-function renderEdge(edgeType: EdgeKind): string {
-  // FeatureEdge expects geometry from React Flow + a data.edgeType tag.
-  const props = {
-    id: `${edgeType}:a→b`,
-    source: 'a',
-    target: 'b',
-    sourceX: 0,
-    sourceY: 0,
-    targetX: 100,
-    targetY: 0,
-    sourcePosition: Position.Right,
-    targetPosition: Position.Left,
-    data: { edgeType },
-    markerEnd: undefined,
-    selected: false,
-    animated: false,
-  } as unknown as React.ComponentProps<typeof FeatureEdge>;
-
-  return renderToStaticMarkup(
-    <ReactFlowProvider>
-      <svg>
-        <FeatureEdge {...props} />
-      </svg>
-    </ReactFlowProvider>,
-  );
-}
-
-describe('FeatureEdge', () => {
-  it('renders a path with the dependency CSS class', () => {
-    const html = renderEdge('dependency');
-    expect(html).toContain('feature-edge--dependency');
-  });
-
-  it('renders a path with the enables CSS class', () => {
-    const html = renderEdge('enables');
-    expect(html).toContain('feature-edge--enables');
-  });
-
-  it('renders a path with the hierarchy CSS class', () => {
-    const html = renderEdge('hierarchy');
-    expect(html).toContain('feature-edge--hierarchy');
-  });
-
-  it('dependency edges render as solid (no strokeDasharray)', () => {
-    const html = renderEdge('dependency');
-    expect(html).not.toMatch(/stroke-dasharray="5 3"/);
-    expect(html).not.toMatch(/stroke-dasharray="2 4"/);
-  });
-
-  it('enables edges render as long-dashed (5 3 pattern)', () => {
-    const html = renderEdge('enables');
-    expect(html).toMatch(/stroke-dasharray="5 3"/);
-  });
-
-  it('hierarchy edges render as fine-dotted (2 4 pattern)', () => {
-    const html = renderEdge('hierarchy');
-    expect(html).toMatch(/stroke-dasharray="2 4"/);
-  });
-
-  it('renders an invisible hitbox path for easier hover/selection', () => {
-    const html = renderEdge('dependency');
-    expect(html).toContain('feature-edge__hitbox');
-  });
-});

-/**
- * @vitest-environment jsdom
- *
- * Tests for FeatureNode — the React Flow node body that surfaces a feature's
- * status, id, priority, progress, and the "false-done" alert when
- * implementation claims complete but verification doesn't back it up.
- *
- * FeatureNode uses @xyflow/react's Handle, which needs the ReactFlowProvider
- * context to render without warning. Wrapping each render in
- * ReactFlowProvider keeps the static-render path clean.
- */
-
-import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
-import { renderToStaticMarkup } from 'react-dom/server';
-import { ReactFlowProvider } from '@xyflow/react';
-import { FeatureNode } from './FeatureNode.js';
-import type { Feature } from '../../core/types.js';
-import type { FeatureNode as FeatureNodeType } from '../lib/graph-builder.js';
-
-function renderNode(feature: Feature): string {
-  // FeatureNode is a memoized React Flow node — call it as a plain component
-  // wrapped in ReactFlowProvider; only `data` is read by the component body.
-  const nodeProps = {
-    id: feature.id,
-    data: { feature },
-    selected: false,
-    dragging: false,
-    type: 'feature' as const,
-    isConnectable: false,
-    positionAbsoluteX: 0,
-    positionAbsoluteY: 0,
-    width: 280,
-    height: 80,
-    zIndex: 0,
-  } as unknown as React.ComponentProps<typeof FeatureNode>;
-
-  return renderToStaticMarkup(
-    <ReactFlowProvider>
-      <FeatureNode {...nodeProps} />
-    </ReactFlowProvider>,
-  );
-}
-
-function makeFeature(overrides: Partial<Feature> = {}): Feature {
-  return { id: 'f', title: 'F', status: 'planned', ...overrides };
-}
-
-describe('FeatureNode — header', () => {
-  it('renders the feature id', () => {
-    const html = renderNode(makeFeature({ id: 'my-feat' }));
-    expect(html).toContain('my-feat');
-  });
-
-  it('renders the feature title', () => {
-    const html = renderNode(makeFeature({ title: 'My Feature' }));
-    expect(html).toContain('My Feature');
-  });
-
-  it('renders priority glyph when set', () => {
-    const high = renderNode(makeFeature({ priority: 'high' }));
-    expect(high).toContain('!!');
-    expect(high).toContain('feature-node__priority--high');
-
-    const low = renderNode(makeFeature({ priority: 'low' }));
-    expect(low).toContain('feature-node__priority--low');
-  });
-
-  it('omits priority glyph when priority is unset', () => {
-    const html = renderNode(makeFeature());
-    expect(html).not.toContain('feature-node__priority');
-  });
-});
-
-describe('FeatureNode — false-done alert', () => {
-  it('shows the ⚠ glyph when implementation=100 but no audit ran', () => {
-    const html = renderNode(
-      makeFeature({
-        status: 'in-progress',
-        progress: { implementation: 100, verification: 0 },
-      }),
-    );
-    expect(html).toContain('⚠');
-    expect(html).toContain('feature-node--false-done');
-    expect(html).toContain('unverified');
-  });
-
-  it('shows the ⚠ glyph when implementation=100 but verification < 100', () => {
-    const html = renderNode(
-      makeFeature({
-        status: 'in-progress',
-        progress: { implementation: 100, verification: 50 },
-        audit: { ran_at: '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z', result: 'partial' },
-      }),
-    );
-    expect(html).toContain('feature-node--false-done');
-  });
-
-  it('hides the ⚠ glyph when audit passed', () => {
-    const html = renderNode(
-      makeFeature({
-        status: 'verified',
-        progress: { implementation: 100, verification: 100 },
-        audit: { ran_at: '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z', result: 'pass' },
-      }),
-    );
-    expect(html).not.toContain('feature-node--false-done');
-  });
-
-  it('hides the ⚠ glyph when implementation < 100', () => {
-    const html = renderNode(
-      makeFeature({
-        progress: { implementation: 50, verification: 0 },
-      }),
-    );
-    expect(html).not.toContain('feature-node--false-done');
-  });
-});
-
-describe('FeatureNode — needs-review flag', () => {
-  it('renders the ↻ glyph when audit.flags.needs_review is true', () => {
-    const html = renderNode(
-      makeFeature({
-        audit: {
-          ran_at: '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z',
-          result: 'pass',
-          ...({ flags: { needs_review: true } } as unknown as object),
-        },
-      }),
-    );
-    expect(html).toContain('↻');
-    expect(html).toContain('feature-node__needs-review');
-  });
-
-  it('omits the ↻ glyph when needs_review is false / unset', () => {
-    const html = renderNode(makeFeature());
-    expect(html).not.toContain('feature-node__needs-review');
-  });
-});
-
-describe('FeatureNode — handles', () => {
-  it('renders source and target handles for React Flow edges', () => {
-    const html = renderNode(makeFeature());
-    expect(html).toContain('feature-node__handle--target');
-    expect(html).toContain('feature-node__handle--source');
-  });
-});
-
-describe('FeatureNode — subpage variant', () => {
-  it('renders feature-node--subpage class when parent is set', () => {
-    const html = renderNode(makeFeature({ id: 'parent.sub', parent: 'parent' }));
-    expect(html).toContain('feature-node--subpage');

-  it('does NOT render feature-node--subpage class for top-level features', () => {

-  it('still renders id, title, status glyph for subpages', () => {

-    expect(html).toContain('Sub');

-/**
- * @vitest-environment jsdom
- *
- * Tests for useFeatures — the trivial bridge that reads window.__TEND_DATA__
- * (the static-HTML build embeds the data there). Two states: loading and
- * populated.
- */
-
-import { describe, it, expect, afterEach } from 'vitest';
-import { useFeatures } from './useFeatures.js';
-import type { Catalog, Feature } from '../../core/types.js';
-
-const W = window as unknown as { __TEND_DATA__?: unknown };
-
-afterEach(() => {
-  delete W.__TEND_DATA__;
-});
-
-describe('useFeatures', () => {
-  it('returns loading=true with no features when window.__TEND_DATA__ is unset', () => {
-    const result = useFeatures();
-    expect(result.loading).toBe(true);
-    expect(result.features).toEqual([]);
-    expect(result.catalog).toBeNull();
-  });
-
-  it('returns the embedded features and catalog when populated', () => {
-    const features: Feature[] = [{ id: 'a', title: 'A', status: 'planned' }];
-    const catalog: Catalog = {
-      schema_version: '1',
-      project_id: 'test',
-      status: 'draft',
-      features: [],
-    };
-    W.__TEND_DATA__ = { features, catalog };
-
-    const result = useFeatures();
-
-    expect(result.loading).toBe(false);
-    expect(result.features).toEqual(features);
-    expect(result.catalog).toEqual(catalog);
-  });
-});
diff --git a/src/ui/hooks/useKeyboardNavigation.test.ts b/src/ui/hooks/useKeyboardNavigation.test.ts
deleted file mode 100644
index 40aa06b..0000000
--- a/src/ui/hooks/useKeyboardNavigation.test.ts
+++ /dev/null
@@ -1,283 +0,0 @@
-/**
- * @vitest-environment jsdom
- *
- * Tests for useKeyboardNavigation — the hook that wires j/k/h/l, arrow keys,
- * Enter/Escape, and v/? into selection + panel actions. Uses a tiny harness
- * component to mount the hook against jsdom, then dispatches KeyboardEvent
- * on window and asserts the registered handlers were called.
- */
-
-import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach, vi } from 'vitest';
-import { createElement } from 'react';
-import { useKeyboardNavigation } from './useKeyboardNavigation.js';
-import type { Feature } from '../../core/types.js';
-
-// Enable act() support — silences "current testing environment is not configured to support act(...)" warnings.
-(globalThis as Record<string, unknown>)['IS_REACT_ACT_ENVIRONMENT'] = true;
-
-function makeFeature(overrides: Partial<Feature> = {}): Feature {
-  return {
-    id: 'a',
-    title: 'A',
-    status: 'planned',
-    ...overrides,
-  };
-}
-
-interface Handlers {
-  onSelect: ReturnType<typeof vi.fn>;
-  onOpenPanel: ReturnType<typeof vi.fn>;
-  onDeselect: ReturnType<typeof vi.fn>;
-  onToggleView: ReturnType<typeof vi.fn>;
-  onToggleLayout: ReturnType<typeof vi.fn>;
-  onToggleHelp: ReturnType<typeof vi.fn>;
-}
-
-function makeHandlers(): Handlers {
-  return {
-    onSelect: vi.fn(),
-    onOpenPanel: vi.fn(),
-    onDeselect: vi.fn(),
-    onToggleView: vi.fn(),
-    onToggleLayout: vi.fn(),
-    onToggleHelp: vi.fn(),
-  };
-}
-
-interface MountOpts {
-  features: Feature[];
-  selectedId?: string | null;
-  isPanelOpen?: boolean;
-  nodePositions?: Map<string, { x: number; y: number }>;
-}
-
-// Mount the hook with createRoot wrapped in act() to flush useEffect synchronously.
-// renderToStaticMarkup is not suitable here — it skips effects, so the keydown
-// listener is never attached.
-async function mountAndRun(opts: MountOpts, h: Handlers, action: () => void): Promise<void> {
-  const { createRoot } = await import('react-dom/client');
-  const { act } = await import('react');
-  const container = document.createElement('div');
-  document.body.appendChild(container);
-  const root = createRoot(container);
-
-  const Harness = () => {
-    useKeyboardNavigation({
-      features: opts.features,
-      selectedId: opts.selectedId ?? null,
-      isPanelOpen: opts.isPanelOpen ?? false,
-      onSelect: h.onSelect,
-      onOpenPanel: h.onOpenPanel,
-      onDeselect: h.onDeselect,
-      onToggleView: h.onToggleView,
-      onToggleLayout: h.onToggleLayout,
-      onToggleHelp: h.onToggleHelp,
-      ...(opts.nodePositions ? { nodePositions: opts.nodePositions } : {}),
-    });
-    return null;
-  };
-
-  await act(async () => {
-    root.render(createElement(Harness));
-  });
-
-  action();
-
-  await act(async () => {
-    root.unmount();
-  });
-  container.remove();
-}
-
-function press(key: string, target?: EventTarget): void {
-  const event = new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key, bubbles: true, cancelable: true });
-  if (target) {
-    target.dispatchEvent(event);
-  } else {
-    window.dispatchEvent(event);
-  }
-}
-
-const features = [
-  makeFeature({ id: 'a' }),
-  makeFeature({ id: 'b' }),
-  makeFeature({ id: 'c' }),
-];
-
-describe('useKeyboardNavigation — j / ArrowDown', () => {
-  beforeEach(() => { document.body.innerHTML = ''; });
-
-  it('selects the first feature when nothing is selected', async () => {
-    const h = makeHandlers();
-    await mountAndRun({ features }, h, () => press('j'));
-    expect(h.onSelect).toHaveBeenCalledWith('a');
-  });
-
-  it('advances to the next feature alphabetically by id', async () => {
-    const h = makeHandlers();
-    await mountAndRun({ features, selectedId: 'a' }, h, () => press('j'));
-    expect(h.onSelect).toHaveBeenCalledWith('b');
-  });
-
-  it('wraps around to the first feature from the last', async () => {
-    const h = makeHandlers();
-    await mountAndRun({ features, selectedId: 'c' }, h, () => press('ArrowDown'));
-    expect(h.onSelect).toHaveBeenCalledWith('a');
-  });
-
-  it('does nothing with an empty feature list', async () => {
-    const h = makeHandlers();
-    await mountAndRun({ features: [] }, h, () => press('j'));
-    expect(h.onSelect).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
-  });
-});
-
-describe('useKeyboardNavigation — k / ArrowUp', () => {
-  beforeEach(() => { document.body.innerHTML = ''; });
-
-  it('selects the last feature when nothing is selected', async () => {
-    const h = makeHandlers();
-    await mountAndRun({ features }, h, () => press('k'));
-    expect(h.onSelect).toHaveBeenCalledWith('c');
-  });
-
-  it('moves to the previous feature', async () => {
-    const h = makeHandlers();
-    await mountAndRun({ features, selectedId: 'b' }, h, () => press('ArrowUp'));
-    expect(h.onSelect).toHaveBeenCalledWith('a');
-  });
-
-  it('wraps from the first feature to the last', async () => {
-    const h = makeHandlers();
-    await mountAndRun({ features, selectedId: 'a' }, h, () => press('k'));
-    expect(h.onSelect).toHaveBeenCalledWith('c');
-  });
-});
-
-describe('useKeyboardNavigation — h/l horizontal navigation', () => {
-  beforeEach(() => { document.body.innerHTML = ''; });
-
-  const positions = new Map<string, { x: number; y: number }>([
-    ['a', { x: 0, y: 0 }],
-    ['b', { x: 100, y: 0 }],
-    ['c', { x: 200, y: 0 }],
-  ]);
-
-  it('moves left to a feature with strictly smaller x', async () => {
-    const h = makeHandlers();
-    await mountAndRun(
-      { features, selectedId: 'b', nodePositions: positions },
-      h,
-      () => press('h'),
-    );
-    expect(h.onSelect).toHaveBeenCalledWith('a');
-  });
-
-  it('moves right to a feature with strictly larger x', async () => {
-    const h = makeHandlers();
-    await mountAndRun(
-      { features, selectedId: 'b', nodePositions: positions },
-      h,
-      () => press('l'),
-    );
-    expect(h.onSelect).toHaveBeenCalledWith('c');
-  });
-
-  it('prefers a dependency feature when navigating left', async () => {
-    const featuresWithDep = [
-      makeFeature({ id: 'far-left' }),
-      makeFeature({ id: 'mid' }),
-      makeFeature({ id: 'right', dependencies: ['far-left'] }),
-    ];
-    const positionsWithDep = new Map([
-      ['far-left', { x: 0, y: 0 }],
-      ['mid', { x: 100, y: 0 }],
-      ['right', { x: 200, y: 0 }],
-    ]);
-    const h = makeHandlers();
-    await mountAndRun(
-      { features: featuresWithDep, selectedId: 'right', nodePositions: positionsWithDep },
-      h,
-      () => press('ArrowLeft'),
-    );
-    expect(h.onSelect).toHaveBeenCalledWith('far-left');
-  });
-
-  it('does nothing on h/l without a selection', async () => {
-    const h = makeHandlers();
-    await mountAndRun(
-      { features, nodePositions: positions },
-      h,
-      () => press('l'),
-    );
-    expect(h.onSelect).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
-  });
-});
-
-describe('useKeyboardNavigation — Enter / Escape', () => {
-  beforeEach(() => { document.body.innerHTML = ''; });
-
-  it('opens the panel on Enter when a feature is selected and panel closed', async () => {
-    const h = makeHandlers();
-    await mountAndRun({ features, selectedId: 'a' }, h, () => press('Enter'));
-    expect(h.onOpenPanel).toHaveBeenCalled();
-  });
-
-  it('does not call onOpenPanel when no feature selected', async () => {
-    const h = makeHandlers();
-    await mountAndRun({ features }, h, () => press('Enter'));
-    expect(h.onOpenPanel).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
-  });
-
-  it('calls onDeselect on Escape when panel is open', async () => {
-    const h = makeHandlers();
-    await mountAndRun(
-      { features, selectedId: 'a', isPanelOpen: true },
-      h,
-      () => press('Escape'),
-    );
-    expect(h.onDeselect).toHaveBeenCalled();
-  });
-
-  it('does nothing on Escape when panel is closed', async () => {
-    const h = makeHandlers();
-    await mountAndRun({ features, selectedId: 'a' }, h, () => press('Escape'));
-    expect(h.onDeselect).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
-  });
-});
-
-describe('useKeyboardNavigation — toggle keys', () => {
-  beforeEach(() => { document.body.innerHTML = ''; });
-
-  it('calls onToggleLayout on v', async () => {
-    const h = makeHandlers();
-    await mountAndRun({ features }, h, () => press('v'));
-    expect(h.onToggleLayout).toHaveBeenCalled();
-  });
-
-  it('calls onToggleHelp on ?', async () => {
-    const h = makeHandlers();
-    await mountAndRun({ features }, h, () => press('?'));
-    expect(h.onToggleHelp).toHaveBeenCalled();
-  });
-});
-
-describe('useKeyboardNavigation — typing target guard', () => {
-  beforeEach(() => { document.body.innerHTML = ''; });
-
-  it('ignores keys when the event target is an input', async () => {
-    const h = makeHandlers();
-    const input = document.createElement('input');
-    document.body.appendChild(input);
-    await mountAndRun({ features }, h, () => press('j', input));
-    expect(h.onSelect).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
-  });
-
-  it('ignores keys when the event target is a textarea', async () => {
-    const h = makeHandlers();
-    const ta = document.createElement('textarea');
-    document.body.appendChild(ta);
-    await mountAndRun({ features }, h, () => press('j', ta));
-    expect(h.onSelect).not.toHaveBeenCalled();

-});

-/**
- * Tests for graph-builder — the pure logic that turns a Feature[] into the
- * React Flow node + edge model the DAG view consumes. Schema-locked: every
- * field we read from Feature is asserted here, so a schema rename surfaces.
- */
-
-import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
-import { buildGraph } from './graph-builder.js';
-import type { Feature } from '../../core/types.js';
-
-function makeFeature(overrides: Partial<Feature> = {}): Feature {
-  return {
-    id: 'feat',
-    title: 'Feature',
-    status: 'planned',
-    ...overrides,
-  };
-}
-
-describe('buildGraph — node construction', () => {
-  it('returns no nodes and no edges for an empty feature list', () => {
-    const { nodes, edges } = buildGraph([]);
-    expect(nodes).toEqual([]);
-    expect(edges).toEqual([]);
-  });
-
-  it('creates one node per feature with id, type, and data.feature attached', () => {
-    const features = [
-      makeFeature({ id: 'a', title: 'A' }),
-      makeFeature({ id: 'b', title: 'B' }),
-    ];
-    const { nodes } = buildGraph(features);
-    expect(nodes).toHaveLength(2);
-    expect(nodes[0]?.id).toBe('a');
-    expect(nodes[0]?.type).toBe('feature');
-    expect(nodes[0]?.data.feature.title).toBe('A');
-    expect(nodes[1]?.data.feature.id).toBe('b');
-  });
-
-  it('assigns a numeric x/y position to each node (dagre layout ran)', () => {
-    const features = [
-      makeFeature({ id: 'a', enables: ['b'] }),
-      makeFeature({ id: 'b' }),
-    ];
-    const { nodes } = buildGraph(features);
-    for (const n of nodes) {
-      expect(typeof n.position.x).toBe('number');
-      expect(typeof n.position.y).toBe('number');
-      expect(Number.isFinite(n.position.x)).toBe(true);
-      expect(Number.isFinite(n.position.y)).toBe(true);
-    }
-  });
-});
-
-describe('buildGraph — dependency edges', () => {
-  it('draws an edge from dep → feature (build order direction)', () => {
-    const features = [
-      makeFeature({ id: 'base' }),
-      makeFeature({ id: 'leaf', dependencies: ['base'] }),
-    ];
-    const { edges } = buildGraph(features);
-    const dep = edges.find((e) => e.data?.edgeType === 'dependency');
-    expect(dep).toBeDefined();
-    expect(dep?.source).toBe('base');
-    expect(dep?.target).toBe('leaf');
-  });
-
-  it('drops dependency edges that point at a feature not in the graph', () => {
-    const features = [makeFeature({ id: 'leaf', dependencies: ['missing'] })];
-    const { edges } = buildGraph(features);
-    expect(edges).toEqual([]);
-  });
-
-  it('does not duplicate a dep edge declared twice', () => {
-    const features = [
-      makeFeature({ id: 'base' }),
-      makeFeature({ id: 'leaf', dependencies: ['base', 'base'] }),
-    ];
-    const { edges } = buildGraph(features);
-    const deps = edges.filter((e) => e.data?.edgeType === 'dependency');
-    expect(deps).toHaveLength(1);
-  });
-});
-
-describe('buildGraph — enables edges', () => {
-  it('draws an edge from feature → enables target (journey direction)', () => {
-    const features = [
-      makeFeature({ id: 'src', enables: ['next'] }),
-      makeFeature({ id: 'next' }),
-    ];
-    const { edges } = buildGraph(features);
-    const en = edges.find((e) => e.data?.edgeType === 'enables');
-    expect(en).toBeDefined();
-    expect(en?.source).toBe('src');
-    expect(en?.target).toBe('next');
-  });
-
-  it('drops enables edges that point at a feature not in the graph', () => {
-    const features = [makeFeature({ id: 'src', enables: ['missing'] })];
-    const { edges } = buildGraph(features);
-    expect(edges).toEqual([]);
-  });
-
-  it('produces both a dep and an enables edge when they overlap (different colors/types)', () => {
-    const features = [
-      makeFeature({ id: 'a', enables: ['b'] }),
-      makeFeature({ id: 'b', dependencies: ['a'] }),
-    ];
-    const { edges } = buildGraph(features);
-    const types = edges.map((e) => e.data?.edgeType).sort();
-    expect(types).toEqual(['dependency', 'enables']);
-  });
-});
-
-describe('buildGraph — subpages hidden from the graph', () => {
-  // Subpages are drill-downs of their parent feature, navigable via the
-  // parent's DetailPanel rail. They are deliberately excluded from the
-  // project-level graph view to keep the node + edge count manageable
-  // and to remove crossing edges from subpage refs to other features.
-
-  it('omits subpages from the rendered node set', () => {
-    const features = [
-      makeFeature({ id: 'parent' }),
-      makeFeature({ id: 'parent.subpage', parent: 'parent' }),
-    ];
-    const { nodes } = buildGraph(features);
-    expect(nodes).toHaveLength(1);
-    expect(nodes[0]?.id).toBe('parent');
-  });
-
-  it('emits no hierarchy edges (parent → subpage edges are part of the hidden subpage layer)', () => {
-    const features = [
-      makeFeature({ id: 'parent' }),
-      makeFeature({ id: 'parent.subpage', parent: 'parent' }),
-    ];
-    const { edges } = buildGraph(features);
-    expect(edges.filter((e) => e.data?.edgeType === 'hierarchy')).toEqual([]);
-  });
-
-  it('drops dep/enables edges that originate from a hidden subpage', () => {
-    // The subpage references `target` via enables; the source is hidden so
-    // the edge would be an orphan line. buildGraph drops it cleanly.
-    const features = [
-      makeFeature({ id: 'parent' }),
-      makeFeature({ id: 'parent.sub', parent: 'parent', enables: ['target'] }),
-      makeFeature({ id: 'target' }),

-/**

- * These tests are RED until the implementation is in place.

-
-import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
-import { renderNarrativeMarkdown } from './narrative-markdown.js';
-
-describe('renderNarrativeMarkdown', () => {
-  // ── Required by the bug report ────────────────────────────────────────────
-
-  it('renders ## heading as <h2>, not literal ##', () => {
-    const html = renderNarrativeMarkdown('## Title\n\nsee `src/x.ts` and **bold**');
-    expect(html).toContain('<h2');
-    expect(html).toContain('Title');
-    expect(html).not.toContain('## Title');
-  });
-
-  it('renders inline `code` as <code>', () => {
-    const html = renderNarrativeMarkdown('## Title\n\nsee `src/x.ts` and **bold**');
-    expect(html).toContain('<code>');
-    expect(html).toContain('src/x.ts');
-    expect(html).not.toContain('`src/x.ts`');
-  });
-
-  it('renders **bold** as <strong>', () => {
-    const html = renderNarrativeMarkdown('## Title\n\nsee `src/x.ts` and **bold**');
-    expect(html).toContain('<strong>');
-    expect(html).toContain('bold');
-    expect(html).not.toContain('**bold**');
-  });
-
-  // ── Headings ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-
-  it('renders ## as <h2>', () => {
-    const html = renderNarrativeMarkdown('## Section');
-    expect(html).toMatch(/<h2[^>]*>.*Section.*<\/h2>/);
-  });
-
-  it('renders ### as <h3>', () => {
-    const html = renderNarrativeMarkdown('### Subsection');
-    expect(html).toMatch(/<h3[^>]*>.*Subsection.*<\/h3>/);
-  });
-
-  // ── Paragraphs ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-
-  it('wraps plain text in <p>', () => {
-    const html = renderNarrativeMarkdown('Hello world');
-    expect(html).toContain('<p>');
-    expect(html).toContain('Hello world');
-  });
-
-  it('splits blank-line-separated blocks into separate <p> elements', () => {

-    const pCount = (html.match(/<p>/g) ?? []).length;
-    expect(pCount).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(2);
-    expect(html).toContain('First paragraph.');
-    expect(html).toContain('Second paragraph.');
-  });
-
-  // ── Inline formatting ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-
-  it('renders *italic* as <em>', () => {

-    expect(html).toMatch(/<em>.*italic text.*<\/em>/);
-    expect(html).not.toContain('*italic text*');
-  });
-
-  it('does not double-render inside bold: **bold `code`** works', () => {
-    const html = renderNarrativeMarkdown('**bold**');
-    expect(html).toContain('<strong>bold</strong>');
-  });
-
-  // ── Empty / falsy inputs ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
-
-  it('returns empty string for empty input', () => {
-    expect(renderNarrativeMarkdown('')).toBe('');
-  });
-
-  // ── No literal syntax leaks ───────────────────────────────────────────────
-

-    expect(html).not.toContain('## ');

-
-  it('does not leak raw backticks in output', () => {

-    expect(html).not.toContain('`npm install`');
-  });
-
-  it('does not leak raw ** in output', () => {

-id_val="$(printf '%s' "$out" | jq -r '.id' 2>/dev/null)"
-_assert "data: id value matches oo-data id field ('builtins-fixture')" \

-_assert "data: outputs steps[0].id" \
-  "$(printf '%s' "$out" | jq -r '.steps[0].id' 2>/dev/null | grep -q '^s1$' && echo 0 || echo 1)"
-_assert "data: outputs smoke.cmd" \
-  "$(printf '%s' "$out" | jq -r '.smoke.cmd' 2>/dev/null | grep -q '^echo smoke-ok$' && echo 0 || echo 1)"
-

-# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

-_assert "status: exits 0" "$([ "$rc" -eq 0 ] && echo 0 || echo 1)"

-_assert "status: contains verif percentage" \

-

-_assert "help: exits 0" "$([ "$rc" -eq 0 ] && echo 0 || echo 1)"
-_assert "help: lists data" \

-_assert "help: lists status" \

-_assert "help: lists smoke" \

-  _assert "help: does NOT list dropped verb '$old_verb'" \

-  _assert "dropped verb '$old_verb': exits non-zero" \

deleted file mode 100644
index edd3404..0000000
--- a/tests/bash/fixtures/builtins-fixture.tend.html
+++ /dev/null
@@ -1,278 +0,0 @@
-#!/usr/bin/env bash
-# Polyglot fixture for built-in verb tests (data, status, help, smoke).
-# Uses the canonical oo-shell-core.sh as the shell section.
-: << 'OO_HTML'
-<!DOCTYPE html>
-<html lang="en">
-<head>
-<meta charset="utf-8"/>
-<title>builtins-fixture · tend</title>
-</head>
-<body>
-
-<!-- OO:STYLE:START -->
-<!-- OO:STYLE:END -->
-
-<!-- OO:RENDER:START -->
-<!-- OO:RENDER:END -->
-
-<!-- OO:DATA:START -->
-<script id="oo-meta" type="application/json">
-{
-  "kind": "feature",
-  "template_version": "2",
-  "generated_at": "2026-05-14T00:00:00Z"
-}
-</script>
-
-<script id="oo-data" type="application/json">
-{
-  "id": "builtins-fixture",
-  "title": "Built-ins Fixture",
-  "status": "in-progress",
-  "what": "Test the polyglot built-in verbs.",
-  "checks": [
-    {"id": "c1", "description": "data prints oo-data", "validates": "what", "method": "synthetic-test"}
-  ],
-  "steps": [
-    {"id": "s1", "title": "First step", "description": "first step prose"}
-  ],
-  "progress": {"implementation": 0, "verification": 0},
-  "smoke": {"cmd": "echo smoke-ok"}
-}
-</script>
-<!-- OO:DATA:END -->
-
-<!-- OO:CLIENT:START -->
-<!-- OO:CLIENT:END -->
-
-</body>
-</html>
-OO_HTML
-
-# OO:SHELL:START
-# template_version: 3
-#
-# Tend polyglot shell core.
-#
-# Five built-in verbs + custom-verb fallback. Bash drives the polyglot's own
-# runtime — reading itself, building itself, verifying itself. Anything that
-# touches multiple files (validate, aggregate, sync, refresh-refs) lives in
-# the MCP server or CLI, not here.
-#
-# Built-ins:
-#   data    Dump oo-data as JSON for jq piping
-#   status  Quick text overview (id, title, status, kind, progress)
-#   help    List available verbs (including any custom ones)
-#   run     Orchestrate the build: iterate steps[], invoke agent per step, smoke
-#   smoke   Run oo-data.smoke.cmd; exit 0/non-0
-#
-# Extension point:
-#   cmd_<verb>  Custom-verb fallback — define a cmd_<name> function in
-#               OO:CUSTOM and it becomes invocable as `bash file <name>`.
-set -euo pipefail
-
-SELF="${BASH_SOURCE[0]}"
-case "$SELF" in
-  /*) ;;
-  *) SELF="$(cd "$(dirname "$SELF")" && pwd)/$(basename "$SELF")" ;;
-esac
-SELF_BASE="$(basename "$SELF")"
-
-# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-# Block extraction
-# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-
-# Extract raw JSON between <script id="..." type="application/json"> and the
-# next </script> (markers excluded). Writes to stdout.
-_extract_block() {
-  local file="$1" block_id="$2"
-  awk -v id="$block_id" '
-    $0 ~ "^[[:space:]]*<script id=\"" id "\" type=\"application/json\">$" { in_block=1; next }
-    in_block && /^[[:space:]]*<\/script>$/ { exit }
-    in_block { print }
-  ' "$file"
-}
-
-# Extract a scalar field from a named block via jq.
-_extract_block_field() {
-  local file="$1" block="$2" field="$3"
-  if ! command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then
-    echo "error: jq is required for $field extraction" >&2
-    return 1
-  fi
-  _extract_block "$file" "$block" | jq -r ".${field} // empty"
-}
-
-# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-# Identity (read live from oo-data and oo-meta)
-# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-
-FEATURE_ID="$(_extract_block_field "$SELF" "oo-data" "id" 2>/dev/null || echo '')"
-TITLE="$(_extract_block_field "$SELF" "oo-data" "title" 2>/dev/null || echo '')"
-STATUS="$(_extract_block_field "$SELF" "oo-data" "status" 2>/dev/null || echo '')"
-KIND="$(_extract_block_field "$SELF" "oo-meta" "kind" 2>/dev/null || echo '')"
-
-# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-# cmd_data — dump oo-data JSON to stdout
-# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-
-cmd_data() {
-  _extract_block "$SELF" "oo-data"
-}
-
-# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-# cmd_status — one-line identity + progress
-# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-
-cmd_status() {
-  local impl_pct verif_pct
-  if command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then
-    impl_pct="$(_extract_block "$SELF" "oo-data" | jq -r '.progress.implementation // 0')"
-    verif_pct="$(_extract_block "$SELF" "oo-data" | jq -r '.progress.verification // 0')"
-  else
-    impl_pct="-"; verif_pct="-"
-  fi
-  printf '%s · %s · %s · %s · impl %s%% · verif %s%%\n' \
-    "${FEATURE_ID:-?}" "${TITLE:-?}" "${STATUS:-?}" "${KIND:-?}" "$impl_pct" "$verif_pct"
-}
-
-# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-# cmd_help — list verbs (including any custom-verb additions)
-# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-
-cmd_help() {
-  cat <<EOF
-tend ${KIND:-artifact}: ${FEATURE_ID:-(unknown)}
-${TITLE:-}
-
-usage: bash $SELF_BASE [VERB]
-
-built-in verbs:
-  data         Dump oo-data as JSON (pipe to jq)
-  status       One-line status to stdout
-  run          Orchestrate the build: iterate steps[], invoke agent per step, run smoke
-  smoke        Run oo-data.smoke.cmd; exit 0/non-0
-  help         Show this
-
-EOF
-
-  # List custom verbs (cmd_* functions besides the built-ins).
-  local custom_verbs
-  custom_verbs="$(declare -F | awk '{print $3}' | grep -E '^cmd_' \
-    | grep -vxE 'cmd_data|cmd_status|cmd_help|cmd_run|cmd_smoke|cmd_default' \
-    | sed 's/^cmd_/  /; s/_/-/g' || true)"
-  if [ -n "$custom_verbs" ]; then
-    cat <<EOF
-custom verbs:
-$custom_verbs
-
-EOF
-  fi
-
-  cat <<EOF
-env:
-  TEND_AGENT_CMD=${TEND_AGENT_CMD:-claude -p}
-
-multi-file ops (validate, aggregate, sync) live in:
-  tend <verb>           CLI
-  tend_<verb>           MCP server
-EOF
-}
-
-# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-# cmd_default — friendly landing when run with no args
-# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-
-cmd_default() {
-  cmd_help
-}
-
-# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-# cmd_smoke — run oo-data.smoke.cmd; exit 0/non-0
-# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-
-cmd_smoke() {
-  if ! command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then
-    echo "error: jq is required for smoke" >&2
-    return 1
-  fi
-  local data smoke_cmd
-  data="$(_extract_block "$SELF" "oo-data")"
-  smoke_cmd="$(printf '%s' "$data" | jq -r '.smoke.cmd // empty')"
-  if [ -z "$smoke_cmd" ]; then
-    echo "smoke: no cmd configured" >&2
-    return 1
-  fi
-  echo "[smoke] $smoke_cmd"
-  eval "$smoke_cmd"

-# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-# cmd_run — orchestrate the build: iterate steps, invoke agent per step, smoke
-# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-#
-# The polyglot is the orchestrator; the agent CLI is the worker. Steps are
-# read from oo-data.steps[]. Each step's description is piped to the agent
-# command on stdin. Any step that exits non-zero halts the run and the
-# trailing smoke step does NOT execute.
-#
-# Agent command resolution order:
-#   1. oo-data.execute.agent_cmd  (file-level override)
-#   2. TEND_AGENT_CMD             (env override)
-#   3. claude -p                  (default)
-cmd_run() {
-  if ! command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then
-    echo "error: jq is required for run" >&2
-    return 1
-  fi
-  local data agent_cmd step step_id step_desc step_first_line
-  local -a agent_arr
-  data="$(_extract_block "$SELF" "oo-data")"
-
-  agent_cmd="$(printf '%s' "$data" | jq -r '.execute.agent_cmd // empty')"
-  if [ -z "$agent_cmd" ]; then
-    agent_cmd="${TEND_AGENT_CMD:-claude -p}"
-  fi
-  read -ra agent_arr <<< "$agent_cmd"
-
-  while IFS= read -r step; do
-    step_id="$(printf '%s' "$step" | jq -r '.id')"
-    step_desc="$(printf '%s' "$step" | jq -r '.description // .title // ""')"
-    step_first_line="$(printf '%s' "$step_desc" | head -1)"
-    echo "[step ${step_id}] ${step_first_line}"
-    if ! printf '%s' "$step_desc" | "${agent_arr[@]}"; then
-      echo "error: step ${step_id} failed" >&2
-      return 1
-    fi
-  done < <(printf '%s' "$data" | jq -c '.steps[]?')
-
-  cmd_smoke
-}
-
-# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-# Dispatcher
-# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-
-case "${1:-}" in
-  "")             cmd_default ;;
-  data)           shift; cmd_data "$@" ;;
-  status)         shift; cmd_status "$@" ;;
-  help|-h|--help) shift; cmd_help "$@" ;;
-  run)            shift; cmd_run "$@" ;;
-  smoke)          shift; cmd_smoke "$@" ;;
-  *)
-    # Custom-verb fallback — look for a function named cmd_<verb> defined in
-    # OO:CUSTOM or appended by a project-local extension.
-    verb="${1//-/_}"; shift
-    if declare -F "cmd_$verb" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
-      "cmd_$verb" "$@"
-    else
-      echo "unknown verb: ${verb//_/-}" >&2
-      cmd_help
-      exit 1
-    fi
-    ;;
-esac
-
-# OO:SHELL:END
