--- a/spikes/loop-hole/tests/proto.spec.ts
+++ /dev/null
@@ -1,139 +0,0 @@
-/**
- * Prototype-pollution safety (SNAG-14). Intent tokens are corpus strings, and
- * corpus strings become keys the moment the tokenizer consults its synonym
- * table. A plain object used as that table carries the whole `Object.prototype`
- * as phantom entries: `SYNONYMS['constructor']` resolves — through the
- * prototype chain — to the `Object` constructor *function*, so the `?? token`
- * fallback never fires and a function flows into the hasher, which crashes on
- * the first real prompt that says the word "constructor".
- *
- * The fixture corpus could never surface this (nobody wrote "constructor" into
- * a seed); the owner's real corpus hit it on run one. The invariant this file
- * pins: no lookup keyed by a corpus string may walk a prototype chain, so every
- * `Object.prototype` name must tokenize and cluster like any other word.
- */
-
-import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
-import { detectRecurrenceCandidates } from '../src/cluster.js';
-import type { ActionEvent, StoredState } from '../src/types.js';
-
-const DAY = 86_400_000;
-const START = Date.parse('2026-06-01T09:00:00Z');
-const NOW = Date.parse('2026-06-08T09:00:00Z');
-
-/** Every own-enumerable-or-not name that lives on `Object.prototype` — the set
- * a naive object-as-map silently inherits. `constructor` is the one that
- * survives lowercasing and actually collided in the field; the rest guard the
- * invariant against a future tokenizer that stops lowercasing. */
-const PROTOTYPE_NAMES = [
-  'constructor',
-  'toString',
-  'hasOwnProperty',
-  'valueOf',
-  'isPrototypeOf',
-  'toLocaleString',
-  'propertyIsEnumerable',
-  '__proto__',
-] as const;
-
-/** Build a corpus whose recurring intent is a single turn text, repeated across
- * enough sessions to clear the intent-occurrence floor and form one cluster. */
-function intentCorpus(turnText: string, occurrences = 4): StoredState {
-  const turns = [turnText];
-  const events: ActionEvent[] = [];
-  for (let i = 0; i < occurrences; i += 1) {
-    const epoch = START + i * DAY;
-    events.push({
-      kind: 'user',
-      ts: new Date(epoch).toISOString(),
-      epoch,
-      project: '/Users/me/repo',
-      session: `session-${i}`,
-      turn: 0,
-    });
-  }
-  return { version: 1, watermark: {}, turns, events };
-}
-
-describe('prototype-name intent tokens tokenize and cluster safely', () => {
-  it('a prompt containing the word "constructor" does not crash the detector (SNAG-14)', async () => {
-    const state = intentCorpus('restart the constructor service after every deploy');
-
-    const candidates = await detectRecurrenceCandidates(state, { now: NOW });
-
-    const intent = candidates.find((candidate) => candidate.kind === 'intent');
-    expect(intent).toBeDefined();
-    // The token must have stayed a string end-to-end; a prototype-chain hit
-    // would have turned it into the Object constructor function before hashing.
-    expect(typeof intent!.label).toBe('string');
-    expect(intent!.label).toContain('constructor');
-    for (const line of intent!.provenance) expect(typeof line).toBe('string');
-  });
-
-  it('every Object.prototype name clusters without walking a prototype chain', async () => {
-    for (const name of PROTOTYPE_NAMES) {
-      const state = intentCorpus(`please review the ${name} handling in the module`);
-
-      // No throw, and a real intent candidate — proving the token was hashed as
-      // a string, not resolved to an inherited function/object.
-      const candidates = await detectRecurrenceCandidates(state, { now: NOW });
-      const intent = candidates.find((candidate) => candidate.kind === 'intent');
-      expect(intent, `no intent candidate for token "${name}"`).toBeDefined();
-      expect(typeof intent!.label).toBe('string');
-    }
-  });
-
-  it('a corpus mixing prototype names with real words still forms one cluster', async () => {
-    // Distinct but near-identical turns that must collapse into one intent —
-    // the clustering path exercised over prototype-collision tokens, not just
-    // the single-turn fast path.
-    const turns = [
-      'refactor the constructor and its toString method',
-      'refactor the constructor plus the toString method again',
-      'refactor the constructor with the toString method once more',
-    ];
-    const events: ActionEvent[] = turns.map((_, i) => {
-      const epoch = START + i * DAY;
-      return {
-        kind: 'user' as const,
-        ts: new Date(epoch).toISOString(),
-        epoch,
-        project: '/Users/me/repo',
-        session: `session-${i}`,
-        turn: i,
-      };
-    });
-    const state: StoredState = { version: 1, watermark: {}, turns, events };
-
-    const candidates = await detectRecurrenceCandidates(state, { now: NOW });
-    const intents = candidates.filter((candidate) => candidate.kind === 'intent');
-    expect(intents).toHaveLength(1);
-    expect(intents[0]!.eventCount).toBe(3);
-  });
-
-  it('shared-stem phrasings still cluster in the lexical fallback (no synonym table)', async () => {
-    // The hand-listed SYNONYMS table is deleted by design (an answer key, not a
-    // product — docs/overfit-postmortem.md); true synonyms are the static
-    // semantic tier's job. The lexical fallback still owes near-duplicate
-    // recall: phrasings differing by one stemmed token must land together.
-    const turns = ['check for pricing updates today', 'check for pricing changes today'];
-    const events: ActionEvent[] = [];
-    for (let i = 0; i < 4; i += 1) {
-      const epoch = START + i * DAY;
-      events.push({
-        kind: 'user',
-        ts: new Date(epoch).toISOString(),
-        epoch,
-        project: '/Users/me/repo',
-        session: `session-${i}`,
-        turn: i % turns.length,
-      });
-    }
-    const state: StoredState = { version: 1, watermark: {}, turns, events };
-
-    const candidates = await detectRecurrenceCandidates(state, { now: NOW });
-    const intents = candidates.filter((candidate) => candidate.kind === 'intent');
-    expect(intents).toHaveLength(1);
-    expect(intents[0]!.eventCount).toBe(4);
-  });
-});

-/**
- * Queued-message re-emission dedup (extract.loop.html c11) — round-5c
- * forensics on the real slice: one session file carried a single authored
- * user message 175 times. SYN-L's uuid dedup (resume-dedup.spec.ts)
- * collapsed the 51 same-uuid copies to one; the surviving 22-strong family
- * turned out to be DISTINCT-uuid records carrying byte-identical content —
- * Conductor's queue machinery re-delivering one authored act, not 22
- * separate asks. Mixed into the same 175 were harness bookkeeping record
- * types (`queue-operation`, `last-prompt`, `attachment`) that are not
- * genuine turns at all.
- *
- * Two closed layers:
- *  1. Record-type allowlist — `applyRecord` (extract.ts) only ever produces
- *     an event from `record.type === 'user' | 'assistant'`; the harness
- *     types above carry neither shape (no `message` field in the real
- *     transcripts) and were already excluded structurally. Proven here
- *     against real-shape fixtures, not assumed.
- *  2. Within-session content collapse (the actual defect): byte-identical
- *     user content within ONE session is the same authored act regardless
- *     of uuid — a human doesn't retype the identical prompt verbatim
- *     several times a minute apart; Conductor's queue does. The same text
- *     asked again in a DIFFERENT session, or a different day, is a genuine
- *     habit and still counts.
- */
-
-import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
-import { mkdtempSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
-import { join } from 'node:path';
-import { tmpdir } from 'node:os';
-import { ClaudeCodeAdapter } from '../src/claude-adapter.js';
-import { runExtract } from '../src/extract.js';
-import { segmentEpisodes } from '../src/episodes.js';
-import { detectPollingFamilies } from '../src/polling.js';
-import { StateStore, EXTRACTION_RULES_VERSION } from '../src/store.js';
-import type { ActionEvent, SessionSource, StoredState } from '../src/types.js';
-import { makeCorpus, userTurn, toolCall, queueOperationTurn, lastPromptTurn, attachmentTurn } from './helpers.js';
-
-const CWD = '/Users/me/repo';
-const MIN = 60_000;
-const BASE = Date.parse('2026-07-24T09:00:00.000Z');
-
-function at(offsetMs: number): string {
-  return new Date(BASE + offsetMs).toISOString();
-}
-
-function userEvents(store: StateStore) {
-  return store.events.filter((e): e is Extract<ActionEvent, { kind: 'user' }> => e.kind === 'user');
-}
-
-/** A record shaped like a real transcript line, with an explicit `uuid` —
- * these tests control identity directly (resume-dedup.spec.ts precedent). */
-function rawUserRecord(uuid: string, text: string, timestamp: string): unknown {
-  return {
-    parentUuid: null,
-    isSidechain: false,
-    userType: 'external',
-    cwd: CWD,
-    type: 'user',
-    message: { role: 'user', content: text },
-    uuid,
-    timestamp,
-  };
-}
-
-describe('queued-message re-emission dedup', () => {
-  it('harness bookkeeping records never intern, and N distinct-uuid identical asks collapse to one', async () => {
-    const askText = 'run the migration script one more time';
-    const root = makeCorpus([
-      {
-        dir: '-Users-me-repo',
-        sessionId: 'sess-queue-storm',
-        records: [
-          userTurn('kick off the migration', at(0), CWD),
-          toolCall('Bash', { command: 'npm run migrate -- --background' }, at(1_000), [], CWD),
-          // Harness bookkeeping mixed into the same session — none of these
-          // are turns.
-          queueOperationTurn(askText, at(2 * MIN), 'sess-queue-storm'),
-          lastPromptTurn(askText, 'leaf-uuid-1', 'sess-queue-storm'),
-          attachmentTurn(at(3 * MIN), CWD, 'sess-queue-storm'),
-          // The real defect: 22 distinct-uuid re-deliveries of one authored
-          // act (round-5c's proven shape).
-          ...Array.from({ length: 22 }, (_, i) => rawUserRecord(`uuid-redeliver-${i}`, askText, at(10 * MIN + i * MIN))),
-          userTurn('great, ship it', at(40 * MIN), CWD),
-          toolCall('Bash', { command: 'git push --tags' }, at(43 * MIN), [], CWD),
-        ],
-      },
-    ]);
-
-    const store = StateStore.empty();
-    await runExtract(new ClaudeCodeAdapter(root), store);
-
-    const askTurn = store.internTurn(askText);
-    expect(userEvents(store).filter((e) => e.turn === askTurn)).toHaveLength(1);
-    // The kickoff + closer asks are still there — only the re-delivered
-    // family collapsed.
-    expect(userEvents(store)).toHaveLength(3);
-
-    const episodes = segmentEpisodes(store);
-    const families = await detectPollingFamilies(episodes);
-    expect(families).toEqual([]);
-  });
-
-  it('the same ask repeated in three separate sessions still counts three times', async () => {
-    const text = 'any update on the deploy?';
-    const root = makeCorpus([
-      { dir: '-Users-me-repo', sessionId: 'sess-a', records: [rawUserRecord('uuid-a', text, at(0))] },
-      { dir: '-Users-me-repo', sessionId: 'sess-b', records: [rawUserRecord('uuid-b', text, at(1 * MIN))] },
-      { dir: '-Users-me-repo', sessionId: 'sess-c', records: [rawUserRecord('uuid-c', text, at(2 * MIN))] },
-    ]);
-
-    const store = StateStore.empty();
-    await runExtract(new ClaudeCodeAdapter(root), store);
-
-    const turn = store.internTurn(text);
-    expect(userEvents(store).filter((e) => e.turn === turn)).toHaveLength(3);
-  });
-
-  it('two different asks in one session both survive', async () => {
-    const root = makeCorpus([
-      {
-        dir: '-Users-me-repo',
-        sessionId: 'sess-two-asks',
-        records: [rawUserRecord('uuid-1', 'run the linter', at(0)), rawUserRecord('uuid-2', 'run the type checker', at(1 * MIN))],
-      },
-    ]);
-
-    const store = StateStore.empty();
-    await runExtract(new ClaudeCodeAdapter(root), store);
-
-    expect(userEvents(store)).toHaveLength(2);
-  });
-
-  it('a store built under the pre-c11 rules version triggers full re-extraction, and the re-delivery family collapses', async () => {
-    const text = 'run the migration script one more time';
-    const root = makeCorpus([
-      {
-        dir: '-Users-me-repo',
-        sessionId: 'sess-poisoned-queue',
-        records: [
-          queueOperationTurn(text, at(0), 'sess-poisoned-queue'),
-          rawUserRecord('uuid-1', text, at(0)),
-          rawUserRecord('uuid-2', text, at(1 * MIN)),
-          rawUserRecord('uuid-3', text, at(2 * MIN)),
-        ],
-      },
-    ]);
-    const adapter = new ClaudeCodeAdapter(root);
-    let signature = '';
-    for await (const session of adapter.sessions() as AsyncIterable<SessionSource> | Iterable<SessionSource>) {
-      if (session.sessionId === 'sess-poisoned-queue') signature = session.signature;
-    }
-    expect(signature).not.toBe('');
-
-    // A store built under the superseded rules that wrongly kept all three
-    // distinct-uuid re-deliveries as separate events — the exact pre-c11
-    // shape.
-    const dir = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'loophole-queue-dedup-'));
-    const storePath = join(dir, 'state.json');
-    const poisoned: StoredState = {
-      version: 2,
-      rulesVersion: EXTRACTION_RULES_VERSION - 1,
-      watermark: { 'sess-poisoned-queue': { signature, eventCount: 3 } },
-      turns: [text],
-      events: [0, 1, 2].map((i) => ({
-        kind: 'user' as const,
-        ts: at(i * MIN),
-        epoch: Date.parse(at(i * MIN)),
-        project: CWD,
-        session: 'sess-poisoned-queue',
-        turn: 0,
-      })),
-    };
-    writeFileSync(storePath, JSON.stringify(poisoned));
-
-    const store = StateStore.load(storePath);
-    expect(store.rulesReset).toEqual({ from: EXTRACTION_RULES_VERSION - 1, to: EXTRACTION_RULES_VERSION });
-
-    await runExtract(adapter, store);
-
-    const turn = store.internTurn(text);
-    expect(userEvents(store).filter((e) => e.turn === turn)).toHaveLength(1);
-  });
-});

-/**

- * "L2 analyst"; check c5 in propose.loop.html). Two things must be true:
- *
- *  1. Reach is COMPUTED from `projectCount` alone — no model, no frequency
- *     input — before anything is ranked.
- *  2. `rankByReach` enforces cross-project-outranks-single-project as a
- *     structural sort property: a theme spanning three or more projects
- *     always beats a single-project theme, even one with far higher raw
- *     frequency. Ties within the same tier break by frequency.
- */
-

-
-function candidate(overrides: Partial<RecurrenceCandidate> & { id: string }): RecurrenceCandidate {

-describe('judgeReach — deterministic computation from project count alone', () => {

-  it('tiers a theme spanning more than the threshold as cross-project', () => {

-
-  it('tiers a single-project theme as single-project', () => {

-
-  it('tiers a theme one short of the threshold as single-project', () => {

-
-  it('is deterministic: the same project count always yields the same judgment', () => {

-  it('respects a caller-supplied threshold', () => {

-describe('candidateReach — decorates a candidate from its own evidence fields', () => {

-  it('marks a single-project candidate accordingly regardless of its event count', () => {

-
-describe('rankByReach — a cross-project theme is never outranked by a louder single-project one', () => {

-  it('never lets any single-project item precede any cross-project item, across a mixed and shuffled set', () => {

--- a/spikes/loop-hole/tests/recall.spec.ts

@@ -1,126 +0,0 @@
-/**
- * Recall — the product's core promise made falsifiable: the recurring intent
- * that is really in the logs must survive the counting/clustering layer. This
- * corpus seeds the five rituals the check names — port-busy checks, MCP-server
- * restarts after builds, CI/PR status asks, validate/cockpit re-runs, and the
- * re-audit cascade after source edits — each with realistic variance (rotating
- * ports, rotating feature ids, re-phrased asks) so the detector is exercised
- * through normalization and clustering, not handed pre-collapsed keys. All five
- * must appear in the shortlist; a miss on any one is a hole in the product.
- */
-
-import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
-import { detectRecurrenceCandidates } from '../src/cluster.js';
-import { normalizeToolCall } from '../src/normalize.js';
-import type { ActionEvent, StoredState } from '../src/types.js';
-
-const DAY = 86_400_000;
-const START = Date.parse('2026-06-01T09:00:00Z');
-const NOW = Date.parse('2026-06-08T09:00:00Z');
-
-// The four tool rituals, keyed exactly as the normalizer will template them —
-// computed from concrete calls so the expectation cannot drift from the code.
-const RITUALS = {
-  /** Port-busy check before starting a dev server — rotating port. */
-  portCheck: normalizeToolCall('Bash', { command: 'lsof -i :5173' }),
-  /** MCP-server restart after a rebuild — the stale-server dance. */
-  mcpRestart: normalizeToolCall('Bash', {
-    command: 'npm run build && pkill -f tend-server && npx tend serve',
-  }),
-  /** Cockpit/validate re-run to check the verdict after a change. */
-  validateRerun: normalizeToolCall('Bash', { command: 'npx tend validate' }),
-  /** The re-audit cascade after a source edit — rotating feature id. */
-  reauditCascade: normalizeToolCall('Bash', { command: 'npx tend audit AR-6' }),
-} as const;
-
-/** Rotating concrete forms that must all collapse to the same template. */
-const PORT_COMMANDS = ['lsof -i :5173', 'lsof -i :8471', 'lsof -i :3000', 'lsof -i :9229'];
-const REAUDIT_COMMANDS = ['npx tend audit AR-6', 'npx tend audit AR-7', 'npx tend audit AR-9', 'npx tend audit AR-12'];
-
-/** CI/PR status asks — re-phrased, but one recurring intent. */
-const CI_PR_TURNS = [
-  'check the CI status on the PR',
-  'check the CI status on the PR again',
-  'check the CI build status on the PR',
-];
-
-function fiveRitualState(): StoredState {
-  const events: ActionEvent[] = [];
-  let seq = 0;
-
-  // Four days of the four tool rituals — recurring, with variance.
-  for (let day = 0; day < 4; day += 1) {
-    events.push(toolEvent('Bash', { command: PORT_COMMANDS[day]! }, day, seq++));
-    events.push(toolEvent('Bash', {
-      command: 'npm run build && pkill -f tend-server && npx tend serve',
-    }, day, seq++));
-    events.push(toolEvent('Bash', { command: 'npx tend validate' }, day, seq++));
-    events.push(toolEvent('Bash', { command: REAUDIT_COMMANDS[day]! }, day, seq++));
-  }
-
-  // The CI/PR ask, re-phrased, asked twice each across six days.
-  for (let i = 0; i < 6; i += 1) {
-    events.push(userEvent(i % CI_PR_TURNS.length, i, seq++));
-  }
-
-  return { version: 1, watermark: {}, turns: [...CI_PR_TURNS], events };
-}
-
-function toolEvent(tool: string, input: unknown, day: number, sequence: number): ActionEvent {
-  const epoch = START + day * DAY + sequence * 1000;
-  return {
-    kind: 'tool',
-    ts: new Date(epoch).toISOString(),
-    epoch,
-    project: '/Users/me/repo',
-    session: `session-${day}`,
-    tool,
-    template: normalizeToolCall(tool, input),
-  };
-}
-
-function userEvent(turn: number, day: number, sequence: number): ActionEvent {
-  const epoch = START + day * DAY + sequence * 1000;
-  return {
-    kind: 'user',
-    ts: new Date(epoch).toISOString(),
-    epoch,
-    project: '/Users/me/repo',
-    session: `session-${day}`,
-    turn,
-  };
-}
-
-describe('recurrence candidate recall', () => {
-  it('finds all five known rituals in the corpus', async () => {
-    const candidates = await detectRecurrenceCandidates(fiveRitualState(), {
-      now: NOW,
-      intentSimilarity: 0.45,
-    });
-    const labels = candidates.map((candidate) => candidate.label);
-
-    // Ritual 1: port-busy checks.
-    expect(labels).toContain(RITUALS.portCheck);
-    // Ritual 2: MCP-server restarts after builds.
-    expect(labels).toContain(RITUALS.mcpRestart);
-    // Ritual 4: validate/cockpit re-runs.
-    expect(labels).toContain(RITUALS.validateRerun);
-    // Ritual 5: the re-audit cascade after source edits.
-    expect(labels).toContain(RITUALS.reauditCascade);
-
-    // Ritual 3: CI/PR status asks — an intent cluster, not a tool template.
-    const intent = candidates.find((candidate) => candidate.kind === 'intent');
-    expect(intent).toBeDefined();
-    expect(intent!.eventCount).toBe(6);
-    const provenance = intent!.provenance.join('\n');
-    expect(provenance).toContain('CI');
-    expect(provenance).toContain('PR');
-
-    // All five rituals surfaced — four tool templates plus the one intent.
-    const distinctToolLabels = new Set(
-      candidates.filter((candidate) => candidate.kind === 'tool').map((candidate) => candidate.label),
-    );
-    expect(distinctToolLabels.size).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(4);
-    expect(candidates.filter((candidate) => candidate.kind === 'intent')).toHaveLength(1);
-  });
-});

-/**
- * Refusal hygiene (c10): every tier that turns a thrown judge error into text
- * a person reads — triage.ts, analyst.ts, synthesis.ts, and run.ts's banners
- * / CLI run-summary lines built on top of them — must render that reason as
- * ONE line, truncated to ~200 chars, never a raw command, prompt, or
- * multi-line dump (the "useless 'Command failed'+full-prompt dump baked into
- * the page" a prior slice run actually hit, report.loop.html's Tried log,
- * 2026-07-08). And when the failure is a judge SPAWN (every real judge is
- * `execFileSync('claude', [...])`, see run.ts's `makeClaudeCliJudge`), the
- * reason must carry the child's own stderr (first line), never `.message`'s
- * "Command failed: <cmd + the whole prompt>" — a rate limit reads as a rate
- * limit, not a wall of shell echo.
- *
- * Three layers, cheapest first: the shared primitive (judge-error.ts) in
- * isolation, each tier's own wiring of it (triage.ts/analyst.ts/synthesis.ts),
- * then the full pipeline (run.ts) proving the same hygienic reason survives
- * into the briefing's banner AND the CLI's run-summary line untouched.
- */
-
-import { mkdtempSync, readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
-import { tmpdir } from 'node:os';
-import { join } from 'node:path';
-import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
-import { extractPayload } from '../../../loop/src/core/extract.js';
-import { judgeErrorReason, sanitizeReason } from '../src/judge-error.js';
-import { triageIntents, type TriageJudge } from '../src/triage.js';
-import { runAnalyst, type AnalystJudge } from '../src/analyst.js';
-import { runSynthesis, type SynthesisJudge } from '../src/synthesis.js';
-import { runPipeline, joinRefusalReasons, tierSummaryLine, synthesisSummaryLine } from '../src/run.js';
-import type { RecurrenceCandidate } from '../src/cluster.js';
-import type { EventTable } from '../src/types.js';
-import { makeCorpus, toolCall, userTurn } from './helpers.js';
-
-const DAY = 86_400_000;
-const START = Date.parse('2026-06-01T09:00:00Z');
-
-/** The shape Node's `execFileSync`/`execSync` throw on a nonzero exit or
- * signal kill — a real judge-spawn failure, not a plain `Error`. */
-interface ChildLikeError extends Error {
-  stderr?: string | Buffer;
-  signal?: string | null;
-  status?: number | null;
-  code?: string;
-}
-
-function makeExecError(opts: {
-  stderr?: string | Buffer;
-  signal?: string;
-  status?: number;
-  code?: string;
-  message?: string;
-}): ChildLikeError {
-  const err = new Error(opts.message ?? 'Command failed') as ChildLikeError;
-  if (opts.stderr !== undefined) err.stderr = opts.stderr;
-  if (opts.signal !== undefined) err.signal = opts.signal;
-  if (opts.status !== undefined) err.status = opts.status;
-  if (opts.code !== undefined) err.code = opts.code;
-  return err;
-}
-
-describe('sanitizeReason — one line, capped, no matter what it was built from', () => {
-  it('collapses a multi-line dump to its first non-blank line', () => {
-    expect(sanitizeReason('\n\n  rate limit exceeded  \nstack trace line 1\nstack trace line 2')).toBe('rate limit exceeded');
-  });
-
-  it('returns an empty string when every line is blank', () => {
-    expect(sanitizeReason('\n   \n\t\n')).toBe('');
-  });
-
-  it('leaves a short single line untouched', () => {
-    expect(sanitizeReason('short reason')).toBe('short reason');
-  });
-
-  it('truncates a long single line to the cap with an ellipsis, never exceeding it', () => {
-    const long = 'x'.repeat(500);
-    const result = sanitizeReason(long);
-    expect(result.length).toBe(200);
-    expect(result.endsWith('…')).toBe(true);
-    expect(result.startsWith('x'.repeat(199))).toBe(true);
-  });
-
-  it('honors a custom max', () => {
-    expect(sanitizeReason('abcdefghij', 5)).toBe('abcd…');
-  });

-describe('end-to-end: a judge spawn failure reads as a rate limit everywhere it surfaces (banner AND run summary)', () => {
-  /** One recurring user ask plus one recurring tool ritual across 4 sessions
-   * — enough to clear the detector's floor for both the triage (intent) and
-   * analyst (tool) lanes in one pipeline pass. */
-  function ritualCorpus(): string {
-    const sessions = [];
-    for (let day = 0; day < 4; day += 1) {
-      const at = (offset: number) => new Date(START + day * DAY + offset * 60_000).toISOString();
-      sessions.push({
-        dir: '-Users-me-repo',
-        sessionId: `session-${day}`,
-        records: [
-          userTurn('is the dev server still stuck?', at(0)),
-          toolCall('Bash', { command: `lsof -i :${8471 + day}` }, at(1)),
-          toolCall('Bash', { command: `kill -9 ${9000 + day}` }, at(2)),
-          toolCall('Bash', { command: 'git status' }, at(3)),
-        ],
-      });
-    }
-    return makeCorpus(sessions);
-  }
-
-  function outDir(): string {
-    return mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'loophole-refusal-hygiene-'));
-  }
-
-  function briefingPayload(outPath: string): string {
-    const html = readFileSync(join(outPath, 'loop-hole-briefing.loop.html'), 'utf8');
-    return extractPayload(html)!.payload;

-
-  const HUGE_PROMPT_MARKER = 'PROMPT-LEAK-MARKER-'.repeat(50);
-
-  function rateLimitedJudge(): () => never {
-    return () => {
-      throw makeExecError({
-        stderr: '\n\nAPIError: 429 rate limit exceeded, retry after 30s\nsome trailing diagnostic noise\n',
-        message: `Command failed: claude -p "${HUGE_PROMPT_MARKER}"\nAPIError: 429 rate limit exceeded, retry after 30s\nsome trailing diagnostic noise\n`,
-      });
-    };
-  }
-
-  it('the triage tier: a thrown judge-spawn error is one line, capped, and stderr-derived in the result, the UNTRIAGED banner, AND the run-summary line — never the prompt', async () => {
-    const corpus = ritualCorpus();
-    const out = outDir();
-
-    const result = await runPipeline({ corpusDir: corpus, outDir: out, triageJudge: rateLimitedJudge() });
-
-    expect(result.triage.applied).toBe(false);
-    const reason = result.triage.reason!;
-    expect(reason).toBeDefined();
-    expect(reason).not.toContain('\n');

-    expect(reason).toContain('APIError: 429 rate limit exceeded');
-    expect(reason).not.toContain('Command failed');
-    expect(reason).not.toContain('PROMPT-LEAK-MARKER');
-
-    const payload = briefingPayload(out);

-    expect(payload).not.toContain('Command failed');
-    expect(payload).not.toContain('PROMPT-LEAK-MARKER');

-    const bannerLine = payload.split('\n').find((line) => line.includes('UNTRIAGED'));

-
-    const summary = tierSummaryLine('triage', result.triage);

-    expect(summary).toContain(reason);
-    expect(summary).not.toContain('Command failed');
-    expect(summary).not.toContain('PROMPT-LEAK-MARKER');
-  });
-

-/**
- * Resumed-session dedup (SYN-L, extract.loop.html c10) — round-5b proved on
- * the real slice: one authored user message, extracted 22 times from one
- * session lineage. A resumed/continued Claude Code session file re-emits
- * prior records verbatim (uuid included); each file generation used to
- * extract them as brand-new events because extraction deduped only on the
- * watermark's session identity, never the record's own. That let a single
- * authored ask masquerade as recurrence — inflating polling-family detection
- * and everything downstream that counts by occurrence.
- *
- * Records here carry the real transcript shape (origin-hygiene.spec.ts's
- * `rawUserRecord` precedent extended with an explicit `uuid`, since these
- * tests need to control identity directly, not just origin fields).
- */
-
-import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
-import { mkdirSync, mkdtempSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
-import { join } from 'node:path';
-import { tmpdir } from 'node:os';
-import { ClaudeCodeAdapter } from '../src/claude-adapter.js';
-import { runExtract } from '../src/extract.js';
-import { segmentEpisodes } from '../src/episodes.js';
-import { detectPollingFamilies } from '../src/polling.js';
-import { StateStore } from '../src/store.js';
-import type { ActionEvent } from '../src/types.js';
-import { makeCorpus, userTurn, toolCall } from './helpers.js';
-
-const CWD = '/Users/me/repo';
-const MIN = 60_000;
-
-function userEvents(store: StateStore) {
-  return store.events.filter((e): e is Extract<ActionEvent, { kind: 'user' }> => e.kind === 'user');
-}
-
-/** A record shaped like a real transcript line, with an explicit `uuid` —
- * these tests control identity directly rather than deriving it. */
-function rawUserRecord(uuid: string, text: string, timestamp: string): unknown {
-  return {
-    parentUuid: null,
-    isSidechain: false,
-    userType: 'external',
-    cwd: CWD,
-    type: 'user',
-    message: { role: 'user', content: text },
-    uuid,
-    timestamp,
-  };
-}
-
-describe('resumed-session dedup', () => {
-  it('a record carried into a resumed continuation file extracts exactly once; genuinely new records still land', async () => {
-    const ask = rawUserRecord('uuid-ask-1', "ah ok, let's use skein for the extraction layer", '2026-07-10T09:00:00.000Z');
-    // No explicit uuid — exercises the content+timestamp fallback identity,
-    // the path a hand-built or legacy-shaped tool record takes.
-    const askTool = toolCall('Bash', { command: 'echo noted' }, '2026-07-10T09:00:01.000Z', [], CWD);
-    const newAsk = rawUserRecord('uuid-ask-2', 'ship it', '2026-07-10T09:10:00.000Z');
-
-    const root = makeCorpus([
-      { dir: '-Users-me-repo', sessionId: 'sess-original', records: [ask, askTool] },
-      // The resumed continuation: a NEW session file (new session id) that
-      // re-carries the exact prior records — same uuids — plus one genuinely
-      // new turn. Real Claude Code resume/compaction re-emits history this
-      // way; only the file identity changes, never the record's own.
-      { dir: '-Users-me-repo', sessionId: 'sess-resumed', records: [ask, askTool, newAsk] },
-    ]);
-
-    const store = StateStore.empty();
-    await runExtract(new ClaudeCodeAdapter(root), store);
-
-    expect(userEvents(store)).toHaveLength(2); // ask + newAsk, each once — never the resumed file's re-carried copies
-    expect(store.events).toHaveLength(3); // + askTool, also once
-  });
-
-  it('duplicate copies of one ask, re-emitted across a resumed session, form no polling family', async () => {
-    const BASE = Date.parse('2026-07-10T09:00:00.000Z');
-    const askUuid = 'uuid-repeat-ask';
-    const askText = 'any update on the migration?';
-    const at = (offsetMs: number) => new Date(BASE + offsetMs).toISOString();
-
-    const root = makeCorpus([
-      {
-        dir: '-Users-me-repo',
-        sessionId: 'sess-resumed-poll',
-        records: [
-          // A substantive kickoff: two real tool calls, never mistaken for a
-          // "quick ask" (mirrors polling-origin.spec.ts's proven shape).
-          userTurn('kick off the migration', at(0), CWD),
-          toolCall('Bash', { command: 'npm run migrate -- --background' }, at(1_000), [], CWD),
-          toolCall('Bash', { command: 'git tag migrate-run' }, at(2_000), [], CWD),
-          // The SAME authored ask, re-carried by six resume/compaction
-          // generations of the SAME session — one identity, six lines.
-          ...Array.from({ length: 6 }, (_, i) => rawUserRecord(askUuid, askText, at(10 * MIN + i * 5 * MIN))),
-          // A substantive closer, well past the "quick ask" duration ceiling.
-          userTurn('great, ship it', at(40 * MIN), CWD),
-          toolCall('Bash', { command: 'git push --tags' }, at(43 * MIN), [], CWD),
-        ],
-      },
-    ]);
-
-    const store = StateStore.empty();
-    await runExtract(new ClaudeCodeAdapter(root), store);
-
-    // The six re-carried copies collapsed to the one record they actually are.
-    const turn = store.internTurn(askText);
-    expect(userEvents(store).filter((e) => e.turn === turn)).toHaveLength(1);
-
-    const episodes = segmentEpisodes(store);
-    const families = await detectPollingFamilies(episodes);
-    expect(families).toEqual([]);
-  });
-
-  it('two genuinely separate asks with identical text but distinct uuids and timestamps both survive', async () => {
-    const text = 'run the tests again';
-    const first = rawUserRecord('uuid-real-1', text, '2026-07-10T09:00:00.000Z');
-    const second = rawUserRecord('uuid-real-2', text, '2026-07-10T10:30:00.000Z');
-
-    const root = makeCorpus([{ dir: '-Users-me-repo', sessionId: 'sess-habit', records: [first, second] }]);
-
-    const store = StateStore.empty();
-    await runExtract(new ClaudeCodeAdapter(root), store);
-
-    const events = userEvents(store);
-    expect(events).toHaveLength(2); // dedup kills copies, never real recurrence
-    expect(new Set(events.map((e) => e.turn)).size).toBe(1); // same interned text, two distinct occurrences
-  });
-
-  it('dedup holds across two incremental runs — the continuation arrives in run 2', async () => {
-    const ask = rawUserRecord('uuid-incremental-ask', 'switch us to skein for extraction', '2026-07-11T09:00:00.000Z');
-
-    const root = makeCorpus([{ dir: '-Users-me-repo', sessionId: 'sess-run1', records: [ask] }]);
-    const adapter = new ClaudeCodeAdapter(root);
-    const storeDir = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'loophole-resume-dedup-'));
-    const storePath = join(storeDir, 'state.json');
-
-    // Run 1: a fresh store, saved to disk the way a real incremental CLI
-    // invocation would — identity must survive the JSON round-trip, not
-    // just live in one process's memory.
-    const run1 = StateStore.empty();
-    await runExtract(adapter, run1);
-    expect(userEvents(run1)).toHaveLength(1);
-    run1.save(storePath);
-
-    // Run 2: a brand-new process loading that store from disk. The resumed
-    // continuation lands as a new session file in the same corpus,
-    // re-carrying the SAME record (same uuid) plus a genuinely new one.
-    const newAsk = rawUserRecord('uuid-incremental-new', 'ship it', '2026-07-11T09:15:00.000Z');
-    const dir = join(root, '-Users-me-repo');
-    mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
-    writeFileSync(join(dir, 'sess-run2.jsonl'), [ask, newAsk].map((r) => JSON.stringify(r)).join('\n') + '\n');
-
-    const run2 = StateStore.load(storePath);
-    await runExtract(adapter, run2);
-
-    expect(userEvents(run2)).toHaveLength(2); // the original ask, still counted once, + the new one
-  });
-});

-/**
- * Real-session floor: sessions below a configurable substance floor — fewer
- * than N genuine (non-empty) user turns — are never sent to the facet
- * reader. The floor operates on the digest's own shape (how many real user
- * turns it carries), never on session id or any other name-shaped signal, so
- * a corpus of thousands of smoke-test artifacts costs zero reader calls
- * without anyone maintaining a list of their names (SNAG-18: a real backfill
- * tried to read all 7,562 watermarked sessions because this floor existed
- * only in a guide, never in code).
- */
-
-import { mkdtempSync } from 'node:fs';

-import type { SessionDigest } from '../src/digest.js';

-function digestOf(episodes: SessionDigest['episodes']): SessionDigest {

-function outDir(): string {
-  return mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'loophole-session-floor-'));
-}
-
-function stubReader(calls: string[]): FacetReader {
-  return (prompt) => {
-    calls.push(prompt);
-    return '[]';
-  };
-}
-
-describe('substance floor predicate', () => {
-  it('defaults to requiring at least two genuine user turns', () => {
-    expect(DEFAULT_MIN_USER_TURNS).toBe(2);

-    const twoTurns = digestOf([
-      { intent: 'first ask', actions: [] },
-      { intent: 'second ask', actions: [] },

-
-  it('is configurable — a caller-supplied floor, not a fixed threshold', () => {

-    expect(meetsSubstanceFloor(oneTurn, 5)).toBe(false);

-  it('does not count an empty or whitespace-only turn as genuine', () => {

-    expect(meetsSubstanceFloor(blankPlusReal, 1)).toBe(true);

-
-  it('a session with zero user turns never clears any positive floor', () => {
-    const toolOnly = digestOf([]);
-    expect(meetsSubstanceFloor(toolOnly, 1)).toBe(false);
-    expect(meetsSubstanceFloor(toolOnly, 0)).toBe(true);
-  });
-});
-
-describe('real-session floor — pipeline wiring', () => {

diff --git a/spikes/loop-hole/tests/stable-keys.spec.ts b/spikes/loop-hole/tests/stable-keys.spec.ts
deleted file mode 100644

--- a/spikes/loop-hole/tests/stable-keys.spec.ts
+++ /dev/null
@@ -1,242 +0,0 @@
-/**
- * Stable suppression keys (design: docs/loop-hole-episodes-design.md; check
- * c7 in propose.loop.html). A cluster's suppression identity must survive
- * two things a naive label-keyed suppression would break under:
- *
- *  1. Retitling — a candidate's display label is a *chosen* representative
- *     (the shortest member turn), free to change on its own even when the
- *     underlying membership hasn't moved at all.
- *  2. Modest membership drift — a run-to-run change of a member or two in an
- *     otherwise-stable cluster, which changes which turns get folded in
- *     without changing "what this recurring ask is."
- *
- * `fingerprintCandidate` builds the identity from member-content hashes, and
- * `ProposalMemory.isSuppressedNear` matches on those hashes with Jaccard
- * tolerance — the display label never enters either comparison.
- */
-
-import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
-import { detectRecurrenceCandidates, type RecurrenceCandidate } from '../src/cluster.js';
-import { clusterKey, runPropose, LocalProposer } from '../src/propose.js';
-import { ProposalMemory, fingerprintCandidate, jaccardSimilarity, type ContentFingerprint } from '../src/memory.js';
-import type { ActionEvent, EventTable } from '../src/types.js';
-
-function candidate(overrides: Partial<RecurrenceCandidate> & { id: string }): RecurrenceCandidate {
-  return {
-    kind: 'intent',
-    label: overrides.id,
-    eventCount: 1,
-    sessionCount: 1,
-    projectCount: 1,
-    firstSeen: '2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z',
-    lastSeen: '2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z',
-    provenance: [],
-    score: {
-      score: 0,
-      components: { frequency: 0, cadenceRegularity: 0, mechanizability: 0, manualCost: 0, stalenessRisk: 0 },
-    },
-    ...overrides,
-  };
-}
-
-/**
- * An intent candidate whose members are exactly `turns[indexes]`, wired the
- * way cluster.ts wires provenance (`turn <index>: <text>`), paired with the
- * fake corpus `memberContent`/`fingerprintCandidate` resolve it against.
- */
-function intentCandidate(
-  id: string,
-  label: string,
-  turns: string[],
-  indexes: number[],
-): { candidate: RecurrenceCandidate; state: EventTable } {
-  return {
-    candidate: candidate({
-      id,
-      kind: 'intent',
-      label,
-      eventCount: indexes.length,
-      provenance: indexes.map((i) => `turn ${i}: ${turns[i]}`),
-    }),
-    state: { events: [], turns },
-  };
-}
-
-const RESTART_TURNS = [
-  'restart the flaky mcp server before standup', // 0
-  'restart the flaky mcp server again', // 1
-  'please restart the flaky mcp server', // 2
-  'restart flaky mcp server one more time', // 3 — v1 only
-  'restart the flaky mcp server right now', // 4 — v2 only
-];
-
-describe('fingerprintCandidate — content, not label', () => {
-  it('is identical for two candidates with the same members but a different display label', () => {
-    const before = intentCandidate('c1', RESTART_TURNS[1]!, RESTART_TURNS, [0, 1, 2]);
-    const after = intentCandidate('c1', RESTART_TURNS[2]!, RESTART_TURNS, [0, 1, 2]); // "retitled"
-
-    expect(clusterKey(before.candidate)).not.toBe(clusterKey(after.candidate));
-
-    const fpBefore = fingerprintCandidate(before.candidate, before.state);
-    const fpAfter = fingerprintCandidate(after.candidate, after.state);
-    expect([...fpAfter.memberHashes].sort()).toEqual([...fpBefore.memberHashes].sort());
-    expect(jaccardSimilarity(fpBefore, fpAfter)).toBe(1);
-  });
-
-  it('degrades gracefully under a modest membership swap', () => {
-    const v1 = intentCandidate('c1', RESTART_TURNS[0]!, RESTART_TURNS, [0, 1, 2, 3]);
-    const v2 = intentCandidate('c1', RESTART_TURNS[0]!, RESTART_TURNS, [0, 1, 2, 4]);
-
-    const similarity = jaccardSimilarity(
-      fingerprintCandidate(v1.candidate, v1.state),
-      fingerprintCandidate(v2.candidate, v2.state),
-    );
-    expect(similarity).toBeCloseTo(3 / 5, 5);
-  });
-
-  it('is zero for wholly unrelated content, and zero across kinds even with matching labels', () => {
-    const turns = ['restart the flaky mcp server again', 'check competitor pricing today'];
-    const a = intentCandidate('a', turns[0]!, turns, [0]);
-    const b = intentCandidate('b', turns[1]!, turns, [1]);
-    expect(
-      jaccardSimilarity(fingerprintCandidate(a.candidate, a.state), fingerprintCandidate(b.candidate, b.state)),
-    ).toBe(0);
-
-    const state: EventTable = { events: [], turns: [] };
-    const toolA = candidate({ id: 'tool-a', kind: 'tool', label: 'Bash(lsof -i :8471)' });
-    const intentA = candidate({ id: 'intent-a', kind: 'intent', label: 'Bash(lsof -i :8471)', provenance: [] });
-    expect(
-      jaccardSimilarity(fingerprintCandidate(toolA, state), fingerprintCandidate(intentA, state)),
-    ).toBe(0);
-  });
-});
-

-describe('runPropose end-to-end — drift-tolerant suppression through the real detector', () => {

-  function stateFor(turns: string[]): EventTable {

-/**
- * A store written before `outcome`/`tokens` existed must still load cleanly:
- * missing tool outcomes default to `'unknown'`, the watermark that gates the
- * next extract pass survives untouched, and the store re-saves stamped as the
- * current version — all without forcing a full re-extraction of sessions the
- * watermark already covers.
- */
-
-import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
-import { readFileSync, writeFileSync, mkdtempSync } from 'node:fs';
-import { join } from 'node:path';
-import { tmpdir } from 'node:os';
-import { ClaudeCodeAdapter } from '../src/claude-adapter.js';

-import { makeCorpus, userTurn, toolCall } from './helpers.js';
-
-/** A v1 payload as it would have been written before outcome/tokens existed:
- * tool events carry no `outcome` field at all, user events carry no `tokens`.
- * Pinned to the CURRENT rules version — this fixture predates only the store
- * SHAPE (rules-version.spec.ts owns the orthogonal RULES-version concern; a
- * mismatch there discards events + watermark, which would defeat every
- * assertion below that they survive migration untouched). */
-function v1Payload() {
-  return {
-    version: 1,
-    rulesVersion: EXTRACTION_RULES_VERSION,
-    watermark: {
-      'sess-legacy': { signature: 'sig-v1', eventCount: 2 },
-    },
-    turns: ['ship the release'],
-    events: [
-      { kind: 'user', ts: '2026-05-01T10:00:00.000Z', epoch: Date.parse('2026-05-01T10:00:00.000Z'), project: '/Users/me/repo', session: 'sess-legacy', turn: 0 },
-      { kind: 'tool', ts: '2026-05-01T10:00:01.000Z', epoch: Date.parse('2026-05-01T10:00:01.000Z'), project: '/Users/me/repo', session: 'sess-legacy', tool: 'Bash', template: 'Bash(npm test)' },
-    ],
-  };
-}
-
-describe('store migration: v1 → v2', () => {
-  it('loads a v1 store cleanly, defaulting missing outcome to unknown and preserving the watermark', () => {
-    const dir = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'loophole-store-migration-'));
-    const storePath = join(dir, 'state.json');
-    writeFileSync(storePath, JSON.stringify(v1Payload()));
-
-    const store = StateStore.load(storePath);
-
-    expect(store.turns).toEqual(['ship the release']);
-    expect(store.events).toHaveLength(2);
-
-    const toolEvent = store.events.find((e) => e.kind === 'tool');
-    if (toolEvent === undefined || toolEvent.kind !== 'tool') throw new Error('expected a tool event');
-    expect(toolEvent.outcome).toBe('unknown');
-    expect(toolEvent.template).toBe('Bash(npm test)');
-
-    const userEvent = store.events.find((e) => e.kind === 'user');
-    if (userEvent === undefined || userEvent.kind !== 'user') throw new Error('expected a user event');
-    expect(userEvent.tokens).toBeUndefined();
-
-    const watermark = store.watermarkFor('sess-legacy');
-    expect(watermark).toEqual({ signature: 'sig-v1', eventCount: 2 });
-  });
-
-  it('re-saves a migrated store as version 2', () => {
-    const dir = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'loophole-store-migration-'));
-    const storePath = join(dir, 'state.json');

-
-  it('does not force a full re-extraction of sessions the migrated watermark already covers', async () => {
-    const dir = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'loophole-store-migration-'));
-    const storePath = join(dir, 'state.json');
-
-    // Build a real corpus and take its actual signature, so the migrated
-    // watermark genuinely matches what the adapter reports next pass.
-    const root = makeCorpus([
-      {
-        dir: '-Users-me-repo',
-        sessionId: 'sess-legacy',
-        records: [userTurn('ship the release', '2026-05-01T10:00:00.000Z'), toolCall('Bash', { command: 'npm test' }, '2026-05-01T10:00:01.000Z')],
-      },
-    ]);
-    const adapter = new ClaudeCodeAdapter(root);
-    let signature = '';
-    for await (const session of adapter.sessions() as AsyncIterable<SessionSource> | Iterable<SessionSource>) {
-      if (session.sessionId === 'sess-legacy') signature = session.signature;
-    }
-    expect(signature).not.toBe('');
-
-    const payload = v1Payload();

-
-    const store = StateStore.load(storePath);
-    const result = await runExtract(adapter, store);

-    expect(result.newSessions).toBe(0);

-/**
- * Suppression memory: a rejected proposal is a decision, not a suggestion. Its
- * cluster does not come back on the next run, and the reason the human gave is
- * kept — so "no" is answered, never silently re-asked.
- */
-
-import { mkdtempSync } from 'node:fs';
-import { join } from 'node:path';
-import { tmpdir } from 'node:os';
-import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
-import { detectRecurrenceCandidates } from '../src/cluster.js';
-import { runPropose, LocalProposer } from '../src/propose.js';
-import { ProposalMemory } from '../src/memory.js';
-import { seededState } from './cluster-fixture.js';
-
-const NOW = Date.parse('2026-06-05T09:00:00Z');
-
-async function seededCandidates() {
-  return detectRecurrenceCandidates(seededState(), { now: NOW, intentSimilarity: 0.45 });
-}
-
-describe('suppression memory', () => {
-  it('does not re-propose a rejected cluster on the next run, and keeps the reason', async () => {
-    const state = seededState();
-    const candidates = await seededCandidates();
-    const proposer = new LocalProposer();
-
-    const first = await runPropose(candidates, state, { proposer, budgetTokens: Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY });
-    expect(first.proposals.length).toBeGreaterThan(1);
-
-    // Reject the top proposal's cluster with a stated reason.
-    const rejected = first.proposals[0]!;
-    const reason = 'already handled by CI — not worth a loop';
-    const memory = ProposalMemory.empty();
-    memory.reject(rejected.clusterKey, rejected.candidateId, rejected.intent, reason, '2026-06-05T10:00:00Z');
-
-    const second = await runPropose(candidates, state, { proposer, budgetTokens: Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY, memory });
-
-    // The rejected cluster is gone; nothing else is.
-    expect(second.proposals.some((p) => p.clusterKey === rejected.clusterKey)).toBe(false);
-    expect(second.proposals.length).toBe(first.proposals.length - 1);
-    expect(second.suppressed).toBe(1);
-    for (const survivor of first.proposals.slice(1)) {
-      expect(second.proposals.some((p) => p.clusterKey === survivor.clusterKey)).toBe(true);
-    }
-
-    // The reason is retrievable — the human's "no" is on record.
-    const decision = memory.decisionFor(rejected.clusterKey);
-    expect(decision?.decision).toBe('rejected');
-    expect(decision?.reason).toBe(reason);
-  });
-
-  it('a later acceptance lifts an earlier rejection of the same cluster', async () => {
-    const state = seededState();
-    const candidates = await seededCandidates();
-    const proposer = new LocalProposer();
-    const baseline = await runPropose(candidates, state, { proposer, budgetTokens: Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY });
-    const target = baseline.proposals[0]!;
-
-    const memory = ProposalMemory.empty();
-    memory.reject(target.clusterKey, target.candidateId, target.intent, 'not now', '2026-06-05T10:00:00Z');
-    expect(memory.isSuppressed(target.clusterKey)).toBe(true);
-
-    memory.accept(target.clusterKey, target.candidateId, target.intent, '2026-06-06T10:00:00Z');
-    expect(memory.isSuppressed(target.clusterKey)).toBe(false);
-
-    const after = await runPropose(candidates, state, { proposer, budgetTokens: Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY, memory });
-    expect(after.proposals.some((p) => p.clusterKey === target.clusterKey)).toBe(true);
-    expect(after.suppressed).toBe(0);
-  });
-
-  it('persists suppression across a save/load round-trip', async () => {
-    const state = seededState();
-    const candidates = await seededCandidates();
-    const proposer = new LocalProposer();
-    const baseline = await runPropose(candidates, state, { proposer, budgetTokens: Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY });
-    const target = baseline.proposals[0]!;
-
-    const path = join(mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'loophole-memory-')), 'memory.json');
-    const memory = ProposalMemory.empty();
-    memory.reject(target.clusterKey, target.candidateId, target.intent, 'redundant', '2026-06-05T10:00:00Z');
-    memory.save(path);
-
-    const reloaded = ProposalMemory.load(path);
-    expect(reloaded.isSuppressed(target.clusterKey)).toBe(true);
-    expect(reloaded.decisionFor(target.clusterKey)?.reason).toBe('redundant');
-
-    const rerun = await runPropose(candidates, state, { proposer, budgetTokens: Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY, memory: reloaded });
-    expect(rerun.proposals.some((p) => p.clusterKey === target.clusterKey)).toBe(false);
-    expect(rerun.suppressed).toBe(1);
-  });
-});

-/**
- * Person-level synthesis (src/synthesis.ts, check c13 on report.loop.html) —
- * the paid comprehension tier's per-session facet FINDINGS must reach the
- * synthesis dossier as first-class citable items, alongside the classified +
- * priced proposals and the cross-session themes, so the briefing prose can be
- * written about the PERSON (their standing instructions, quality bars,
- * working patterns, frictions) in their own verbatim voice — not just narrate
- * the proposal ranking. Themes are aggregates and lose the verbatim voice;
- * findings carry it. This is the same evaporation class as the pre-#44
- * typology collapse, one layer up: intelligence spent on fragments, then the
- * specific material dropped one layer before the page.
- *
- * Four behavior classes, all at the application layer (a deterministic stub
- * stands in for the model; the model itself is proven on real data + human
- * verdicts, never mocked as the unit under test):
- *  - (a) a dossier built from findings carries them as `[f:<id>]`-citable
- *        items in their own namespace, verbatim quotes intact;
- *  - (b) prose citing a finding token with a verbatim quote survives;
- *  - (c) prose citing an invented finding id, or MISQUOTING a real finding, is
- *        dropped fail-closed with the drop counted;
- *  - (d) END TO END through the one-command pipeline: on a corpus carrying
- *        facet findings, the emitted briefing prose cites at least one finding
- *        item — prose citing only proposal items leaves the person's own voice
- *        on the table, the failing condition this check exists to catch.
- */
-
-import { mkdtempSync, readFileSync, rmSync } from 'node:fs';
-import { tmpdir } from 'node:os';
-import { join } from 'node:path';
-import { afterEach, describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
-import { extractPayload } from '../../../loop/src/core/extract.js';
-import { runPipeline } from '../src/run.js';
-import type { FacetCategory, FacetReader } from '../src/facets.js';
-import {
-  buildSynthesisDossier,
-  validateSynthesisProse,
-  type DossierFinding,
-} from '../src/synthesis.js';
-import { makeCorpus, toolCall, userTurn } from './helpers.js';
-import {
-  FINDING_MISQUOTE,
-  FINDING_QUOTE,
-  FINDING_SUMMARY,
-} from './synthesis-fixtures.js';
-
-function finding(spec: {
-  session: string;
-  category: FacetCategory;
-  summary: string;
-  quotes: string[];
-}): DossierFinding {
-  return { session: spec.session, category: spec.category, summary: spec.summary, quotes: spec.quotes };
-}
-
-describe('buildSynthesisDossier — findings as first-class citable items', () => {
-  it('carries every finding in its own [f:<id>] namespace with verbatim quotes intact', () => {
-    const dossier = buildSynthesisDossier([], [], [
-      finding({ session: 'sess-a', category: 'quality-bar', summary: FINDING_SUMMARY, quotes: [FINDING_QUOTE] }),
-    ]);
-
-    expect(dossier.findings).toHaveLength(1);
-    const [item] = dossier.findings;
-    expect(item!.kind).toBe('finding');
-    expect(item!.category).toBe('quality-bar');
-    expect(item!.quotes).toEqual([FINDING_QUOTE]);
-    // The id is a dossier-local sequence number in its own namespace — a
-    // proposal and a finding may reuse the same number, disambiguated by p:/f:.
-    expect(item!.id).toBe('1');
-  });
-
-  it('caps findings by a deterministic priority (category weight × frequency) and COUNTS the capped-out ones', () => {
-    // instruction outweighs tool-candidate; a two-quote finding outweighs a
-    // one-quote one within the same category. With a cap of 1, the single
-    // richest finding survives and the rest are counted, never silently cut.
-    const findings = [
-      finding({ session: 's1', category: 'tool-candidate', summary: FINDING_SUMMARY, quotes: [FINDING_QUOTE] }),
-      finding({ session: 's2', category: 'instruction', summary: FINDING_SUMMARY, quotes: [FINDING_QUOTE, FINDING_MISQUOTE] }),
-      finding({ session: 's3', category: 'instruction', summary: FINDING_SUMMARY, quotes: [FINDING_QUOTE] }),
-    ];
-
-    const dossier = buildSynthesisDossier([], [], findings, { maxFindings: 1 });
-
-    expect(dossier.findings).toHaveLength(1);
-    expect(dossier.findings[0]!.category).toBe('instruction');
-    expect(dossier.findings[0]!.frequency).toBe(2);
-    expect(dossier.cappedFindings).toBe(2);
-  });
-});
-

-const DAY = 86_400_000;
-const START = Date.parse('2026-06-01T09:00:00Z');
-
-/** A corpus whose sessions carry the person's own verbatim standing bar as a
- * user turn, so a facet reader can surface it as a finding whose quote
- * resolves against the session's own digest (facets.ts's quote-honesty gate). */
-function findingCorpus(): string {
-  const sessions = [];
-  for (let day = 0; day < 2; day += 1) {
-    const at = (offset: number) => new Date(START + day * DAY + offset * 60_000).toISOString();
-    sessions.push({
-      dir: '-Users-me-repo',
-      sessionId: `finding-session-${day}`,
-      records: [
-        userTurn(FINDING_QUOTE, at(0)),
-        userTurn('and keep the changelog current on every merge', at(1)),
-        toolCall('Bash', { command: 'git status' }, at(2)),
-      ],
-    });
-  }
-  return makeCorpus(sessions);
-}
-
-/** A reader that reports the person's standing bar as one quality-bar finding
- * per session, quoting the exact user turn so quote-honesty resolves it. */
-function findingReader(): FacetReader {
-  return () =>
-    JSON.stringify([{ category: 'quality-bar', summary: FINDING_SUMMARY, quotes: [FINDING_QUOTE] }]);
-}
-
-/** Pull the first finding straight out of the REAL prompt a synthesis call
- * receives — never a guessed id — so a stub judge cites an item that actually
- * exists. */
-function firstFindingFromPrompt(prompt: string): { id: string; quotes: string[] } {
-  const marker = 'FACET FINDINGS — cite as [f:<id>]:\n';
-  const start = prompt.indexOf(marker);
-  if (start === -1) throw new Error('synthesis prompt carried no FACET FINDINGS block');
-  const bodyStart = start + marker.length;
-  const bodyEnd = prompt.indexOf('\n\n', bodyStart);
-  const findings = JSON.parse(prompt.slice(bodyStart, bodyEnd === -1 ? undefined : bodyEnd)) as Array<{
-    id: string;
-    quotes: string[];
-  }>;
-  const [first] = findings;
-  if (first === undefined) throw new Error('the dossier carried no findings to cite');
-  return first;
-}
-
-const outDirs: string[] = [];
-afterEach(() => {
-  for (const dir of outDirs.splice(0)) rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true });
-});
-
-function outDir(): string {
-  const dir = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'loop-hole-synthesis-person-'));
-  outDirs.push(dir);
-  return dir;
-}
-
-function briefingPayload(outPath: string): string {
-  const html = readFileSync(join(outPath, 'loop-hole-briefing.loop.html'), 'utf8');
-  return extractPayload(html)!.payload;
-}
-
-describe('pipeline wiring — the person is in the briefing, not just the ranking (c13, end to end)', () => {
-  it('a person-first judge citing a finding survives end to end; the emitted briefing quotes the person in the finding namespace', async () => {
-    const corpus = findingCorpus();
-    const out = outDir();
-
-    const result = await runPipeline({
-      corpusDir: corpus,
-      outDir: out,
-      facetReader: findingReader(),
-      synthesisJudge: (prompt) => {
-        const first = firstFindingFromPrompt(prompt);
-        return `## Standing bars\nYou keep telling your agents "${first.quotes[0]}" [f:${first.id}].`;
-      },
-    });
-
-    expect(result.synthesis.applied).toBe(true);
-    expect(result.synthesis.droppedSentences).toBe(0);
-
-    const payload = briefingPayload(out);
-    expect(payload).not.toContain('UNSYNTHESIZED');
-    // The person's own voice, in the finding namespace, made it to the page.
-    expect(payload).toMatch(/\[f:\d+\]/);
-    expect(payload).toContain(FINDING_QUOTE);
-  });
-
-  it('prose citing ONLY proposal items leaves the finding namespace off the page — the person-blind failing condition', async () => {
-    const corpus = findingCorpus();
-    const out = outDir();
-
-    // A judge that cites only proposals: on a corpus that carries findings,
-    // its briefing never quotes the person in the [f:<id>] namespace.
-    const proposalOnly = (prompt: string): string => {
-      const marker = 'PROPOSALS — cite as [p:<id>]:\n';
-      const start = prompt.indexOf(marker) + marker.length;
-      const end = prompt.indexOf('\n\nFACET THEMES', start);
-      const proposals = JSON.parse(prompt.slice(start, end)) as Array<{ id: string; eventCount: number }>;
-      const first = proposals[0];
-      if (first === undefined) return '## Recurs\nNothing recurs here at all in this run.';
-      return `## Recurs\nThis recurred ${first.eventCount} time(s) [p:${first.id}].`;
-    };
-
-    await runPipeline({
-      corpusDir: corpus,
-      outDir: out,
-      facetReader: findingReader(),
-      synthesisJudge: proposalOnly,
-    });
-
-    const payload = briefingPayload(out);
-    expect(payload).not.toMatch(/\[f:\d+\]/);
-  });
-});

-/**
- * The synthesis tier (src/synthesis.ts, design: docs/loop-hole-episodes-
- * design.md "v4: the synthesis inversion") — the one call that WRITES the
- * briefing's lead instead of leaving it to report.ts's template glue. Four
- * properties are proven here, all at the application layer (a deterministic
- * stub stands in for the model; the model itself is proven on real data +
- * human verdicts, never mocked as the unit under test):
- *  - citation discipline: a sentence survives only when it ends in exactly
- *    one citation token that resolves against the dossier;
- *  - number recomputation: every number a surviving sentence states must
- *    match its cited item's own numbers, exactly;
- *  - fail-closed refusal: a throwing judge, or one whose every sentence fails
- *    validation, degrades to the template briefing with a visible
- *    UNSYNTHESIZED banner — never a partial, unmarked degradation;
- *  - form-flow correctness: the dossier's forms come from each proposal's own
- *    `form` field (typology.ts + themes.ts's category mapping), never from
- *    the coarser `dossier.kind` — a mixed-shape input must never collapse
- *    into one form.
- */
-

-function makeProposal(spec: ProposalSpec): Proposal {

-    intent: spec.intent,

-    fitnessFunction: {

-    citations: spec.quotes,
-    dossier: {

-      label: spec.intent,

-      sessionCount,
-      projectCount,

-      cadence: [],

-    expect(result.text).not.toContain('invented');
-  });

-
-const DAY = 86_400_000;
-const START = Date.parse('2026-06-01T09:00:00Z');
-
-/** A small, clearly-recurring corpus — just enough for the propose stage to
- * survive at least one proposal, deterministically. */
-function ritualCorpus(): string {
-  const sessions = [];
-  for (let day = 0; day < 4; day += 1) {
-    const at = (offset: number) => new Date(START + day * DAY + offset * 60_000).toISOString();
-    sessions.push({
-      dir: '-Users-me-repo',
-      sessionId: `session-${day}`,
-      records: [
-        userTurn('is the nightly ingest job still green?', at(0)),
-        toolCall('Bash', { command: `lsof -i :${8471 + day}` }, at(1)),
-        toolCall('Bash', { command: 'git status' }, at(2)),
-      ],
-    });
-  }
-  return makeCorpus(sessions);
-}
-
-const outDirs: string[] = [];
-afterEach(() => {
-  for (const dir of outDirs.splice(0)) rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true });
-});
-
-function outDir(): string {
-  const dir = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'loop-hole-synthesis-'));
-  outDirs.push(dir);
-  return dir;
-}
-
-function briefingPayload(outPath: string): string {
-  const html = readFileSync(join(outPath, 'loop-hole-briefing.loop.html'), 'utf8');
-  return extractPayload(html)!.payload;
-}

-/** Pull the first proposal straight out of the REAL prompt text a synthesis
- * call would receive — never a guessed id — so a stub judge can cite a
- * dossier item that actually exists without depending on this file's own
- * id-assignment assumptions. */
-function firstProposalFromPrompt(prompt: string): { id: string; eventCount: number; sessionCount: number } {
-  const marker = 'PROPOSALS — cite as [p:<id>]:\n';
-  const start = prompt.indexOf(marker) + marker.length;
-  const end = prompt.indexOf('\n\nFACET THEMES', start);
-  const proposals = JSON.parse(prompt.slice(start, end)) as Array<{ id: string; eventCount: number; sessionCount: number }>;
-  const [first] = proposals;
-  if (first === undefined) throw new Error('test corpus produced no proposals to cite');
-  return first;
-}

-describe('pipeline wiring — template-fallback e2e stays green with all judges off', () => {

-describe('pipeline wiring — a validated synthesis lead becomes the briefing\'s lead, receipts follow', () => {

-/**
- * Tier floors (propose.loop.html c12) — the SYN-F diagnosis pinned: the
- * remainder-budget sequence ran abundant tiers first, so on any real corpus
- * the mixed intent pass filled every user slot (polling got
- * `maxUser - maxUser = 0`) and the tool pass filled the agent remainder
- * (chains got `max - user - tool = 0`). Detection fired — 39 chains, 14
- * polling families on the real slice — and emission was ARITHMETICALLY zero.
- * c10's mixed-shape fixture couldn't catch it: its sparse corpus left
- * remainders everywhere.
- *
- * The pinned behavior: an evidence tier with detected candidates holds a
- * small reserved quota AHEAD of the abundant passes — rare, high-signal
- * material (a missing tool, a push loop) is never starved to zero by sheer
- * intent volume. Totals never exceed the same caps as before.
- */
-
-import { mkdtempSync, rmSync } from 'node:fs';

-// Early enough that day 80 still lands in the past — extract.ts's sane-window
-// guard drops future timestamps (that lesson cost this spec its first RED).
-const BASE = Date.parse('2026-03-01T09:00:00.000Z');
-const DAY = 86_400_000;
-const MIN = 60_000;
-
-function ts(day: number, offsetMin = 0): string {
-  return new Date(BASE + day * DAY + offsetMin * MIN).toISOString();

-
-/** Twelve distinct recurring asks — more than every user slot the pipeline
- * has (DEFAULT_MAX_USER_PROPOSALS is 10, and this spec passes maxProposals
- * low enough that intents alone can fill the whole run). Same text per
- * intent across its sessions so cluster.ts groups each one. */
-const INTENT_ASKS = [
-  'is the nightly ingest job still green?',
-  'how did the morning sync land',
-  'give me the open review queue',
-  'anything waiting on my sign off',
-  'summarize the overnight alerts',
-  'is staging still healthy',
-  'what merged since yesterday',
-  'list the flaky suites from last night',
-  'did the backup window complete',

-/** A corpus whose intent volume alone fills every slot, which ALSO carries a
- * workaround chain (failing status probe -> hand-read log), a clean
- * procedure chain, recurring tool templates (agent lane), and a polling
- * burst — the material the old remainder arithmetic starved to zero. */
-function abundantCorpus(): string {
-  const dir = '-Users-me-repo';
-  const sessions = [];
-
-  for (const [i, ask] of INTENT_ASKS.entries()) {
-    for (let d = 0; d < 4; d += 1) {
-      sessions.push({
-        dir,
-        sessionId: `intent-${i}-${d}`,
-        records: [userTurn(ask, ts(i * 4 + d, 0))],
-      });
-    }
-  }
-
-  // Agent-lane tool recurrence — competes for the agent remainder the way
-  // the real corpus's rituals did.
-  for (const tool of ['make lint-all', 'make typegen', 'make docs-sync']) {
-    for (let d = 50; d < 53; d += 1) {
-      sessions.push({
-        dir,
-        sessionId: `tool-${tool.replaceAll(' ', '_')}-${d}`,
-        records: [
-          userTurn(`run ${tool} please`, ts(d, 0)),
-          toolCallRecord(`m-${tool}-${d}`, `t-${tool}-${d}`, 'Bash', { command: tool }, ts(d, 1), {}),
-          toolResult(`t-${tool}-${d}`, false, ts(d, 1), 'ok'),
-        ],
-      });
-    }
-  }
-
-  // Workaround chain: the status endpoint fails, the agent hand-reads the
-  // deploy log every time — missing-tool evidence.
-  for (let d = 60; d < 63; d += 1) {
-    sessions.push({
-      dir,
-      sessionId: `workaround-${d}`,
-      records: [
-        userTurn(`did deploy ${d} finish`, ts(d, 0)),
-        toolCallRecord(`m-wa-${d}-1`, `t-wa-${d}-1`, 'Bash', { command: 'curl https://deploy-status.example.com/health' }, ts(d, 1), {}),
-        toolResult(`t-wa-${d}-1`, true, ts(d, 1), 'connection refused'),
-        toolCallRecord(`m-wa-${d}-2`, `t-wa-${d}-2`, 'Bash', { command: 'cat /var/log/deploy.log' }, ts(d, 2), {}),
-        toolResult(`t-wa-${d}-2`, false, ts(d, 2), 'deploy finished'),
-      ],
-    });
-  }
-
-  // Clean procedure chain — distilled-skill evidence.
-  for (let d = 70; d < 73; d += 1) {
-    sessions.push({
-      dir,
-      sessionId: `skill-${d}`,
-      records: [
-        userTurn(`please run the release pipeline for build ${d}`, ts(d, 0)),
-        toolCallRecord(`m-skill-${d}-1`, `t-skill-${d}-1`, 'Bash', { command: 'npm run build' }, ts(d, 1), {}),
-        toolResult(`t-skill-${d}-1`, false, ts(d, 1), 'build ok'),
-        toolCallRecord(`m-skill-${d}-2`, `t-skill-${d}-2`, 'Bash', { command: 'npm test' }, ts(d, 2), {}),
-        toolResult(`t-skill-${d}-2`, false, ts(d, 2), 'tests ok'),
-      ],
-    });
-  }
-
-  // Polling burst — push-loop evidence. POLLING_CHECKIN_TURNS (not
-  // POLLING_BURST_TURNS): same-ask under the real calibrated embedder
-  // (episodes.loop.html c9), so the real pipeline's semantic gate still
-  // recognizes this as one family.
-  sessions.push({
-    dir,
-    sessionId: 'polling-burst',
-    records: POLLING_CHECKIN_TURNS.map((text, i) => userTurn(text, ts(80, 10 + i * 5))),
-  });
-
-  return makeCorpus(sessions);
-}
-
-describe('tier floors — abundant tiers can never starve detected trace evidence to zero', () => {
-  const outDirs: string[] = [];
-  afterEach(() => {

-  function outDir(): string {

-    outDirs.push(dir);

-
-  it('a corpus whose intents alone fill every slot still emits its detected chain and polling proposals', async () => {

-    // maxProposals 12: the 12 recurring intents can fill the whole run on

-    const result = await runPipeline({ corpusDir: corpus, outDir: out, maxProposals: 12 });

-    expect(result.chains, 'both chains must be detected').toBe(2);
-    expect(result.pollingFamilies, 'the polling burst must be detected').toBe(1);
-
-    const forms = result.propose.proposals.map((p) => p.form);

-    expect(result.propose.proposals.length, 'floors reserve within the cap, never above it').toBeLessThanOrEqual(12);

-
-  it('with no detected trace evidence, floors reserve nothing and intents keep every slot', async () => {

-
-    expect(result.chains).toBe(0);

-/**
- * Toil-value ranking (c11, propose.loop.html) — the briefing's within-tier
- * order is cost-of-toil, never raw recurrence. The 2026-07-18 owner verdict
- * on the real slice output: a 30-second markdown-export convenience (seen
- * often, zero friction) must never outrank a 13-minute audit-discipline
- * failure (seen rarely, three human interventions) — the earlier formula
- * (frequency × median duration only, report.ts's now-removed `toilCost`)
- * already priced that case correctly in isolation, but buried `interventions`
- * as a same-value tie-break that a real value tie almost never reaches. This
- * spec locks the friction-weighted formula (toil.ts's `toilValue`) into the
- * actual ranking seam (report.ts's `rankByReachThenToil`), not just the pure
- * function in isolation.
- */
-
-import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
-import { toilValue, type ToilPricing } from '../src/toil.js';
-import { rankByReachThenToil, type EmittedProposalPages } from '../src/report.js';
-import type { Proposal } from '../src/propose.js';
-
-function pricing(overrides: Partial<ToilPricing>): ToilPricing {
-  return { frequency: 1, medianDurationMs: 1_000, interventions: 0, ...overrides };
-}
-
-function item(id: string, projectCount: number, toil: ToilPricing): EmittedProposalPages {

-      draft: true,
-    },
-    payoff: `${id} saves recurring work.`,
-    citations: [`Bash(${id})`],
-    dossier: {
-      candidateId: id,
-      clusterKey: `tool:${id}`,
-      kind: 'tool',
-      label: `Bash(${id})`,
-      eventCount: toil.frequency,
-      sessionCount: toil.frequency,
-      projectCount,
-      projects: Array.from({ length: Math.max(projectCount, 1) }, (_, i) => `/Users/me/repo${i}`),
-      cadence: [],
-      exemplars: [`Bash(${id})`],
-      toil,
-      firstSeen: '2026-06-01T09:00:00.000Z',
-      lastSeen: '2026-06-04T09:00:00.000Z',
-      fingerprint: { kind: 'tool', memberHashes: [`Bash(${id})`] },
-    },
-    tokensUsed: 64,
-  };
-  return {
-    proposal,
-    opportunity: { id: `${id}-opportunity`, path: `/tmp/${id}-opportunity.loop.html`, href: `${id}-opportunity.loop.html` },
-    draft: { id: `${id}-draft`, path: `/tmp/${id}-draft.loop.html`, href: `${id}-draft.loop.html` },
-  };
-}
-
-describe('toilValue — pure cost-of-toil scalar (toil.ts)', () => {
-  it('a low-frequency high-cost, high-friction shape prices above a high-frequency trivial one', () => {
-    const auditSweep = toilValue(pricing({ frequency: 3, medianDurationMs: 12 * 60_000, interventions: 3 }));
-    const mdExport = toilValue(pricing({ frequency: 13, medianDurationMs: 30_000, interventions: 0 }));
-    expect(auditSweep).toBeGreaterThan(mdExport);

-
-  it('is pure and deterministic: the same pricing always yields the same value', () => {
-    const toil = pricing({ frequency: 5, medianDurationMs: 45_000, interventions: 2 });
-    expect(toilValue(toil)).toBe(toilValue(toil));
-    expect(toilValue({ ...toil })).toBe(toilValue({ ...toil }));
-  });
-
-  it('a shape with no measured duration still prices above zero (the floor), never erasing its own frequency', () => {
-    const value = toilValue(pricing({ frequency: 4, medianDurationMs: 0, interventions: 0 }));
-    expect(value).toBeGreaterThan(0);
-  });
-
-  it('an unpriced shape (no duration evidence at all) values at zero, never a fabricated positive number', () => {
-    expect(toilValue({ frequency: 0, medianDurationMs: 0, interventions: 0, priced: false })).toBe(0);
-  });
-});
-
-describe('rankByReachThenToil — briefing order is cost-of-toil, never raw frequency (c11)', () => {
-  it('a rare, costly, friction-heavy item outranks a frequent, trivial item in the same reach tier', () => {
-    const auditSweep = item('audit-sweep', 1, pricing({ frequency: 3, medianDurationMs: 12 * 60_000, interventions: 3 }));
-    const mdExport = item('md-export', 1, pricing({ frequency: 13, medianDurationMs: 30_000, interventions: 0 }));
-
-    const ranked = rankByReachThenToil([mdExport, auditSweep]);
-
-    expect(ranked.map((r) => r.proposal.candidateId)).toEqual(['audit-sweep', 'md-export']);

-
-  it('friction alone can flip the order: fewer, shorter-but-costlier-in-interventions occurrences outrank more frequent, cleaner ones', () => {
-    // Old formula (frequency × median duration, no friction weight):
-    // heavyFriction = 2 * 100_000 = 200_000; clean = 5 * 50_000 = 250_000 — clean would win.
-    // New formula (recurrence × median duration × (1 + interventions)):
-    // heavyFriction = 2 * 100_000 * 6 = 1_200_000; clean = 5 * 50_000 * 1 = 250_000 — heavyFriction wins.
-    const heavyFriction = item('heavy-friction', 1, pricing({ frequency: 2, medianDurationMs: 100_000, interventions: 5 }));
-    const clean = item('clean', 1, pricing({ frequency: 5, medianDurationMs: 50_000, interventions: 0 }));
-
-    const ranked = rankByReachThenToil([clean, heavyFriction]);
-
-    expect(ranked.map((r) => r.proposal.candidateId)).toEqual(['heavy-friction', 'clean']);
-  });
-
-  it('reach-tier precedence is preserved: a cross-project item with trivial toil still outranks a single-project item with enormous toil', () => {
-    const crossProject = item('cross', 3, pricing({ frequency: 1, medianDurationMs: 100, interventions: 0 }));
-    const singleProjectHeavy = item(
-      'single-heavy',
-      1,
-      pricing({ frequency: 1_000, medianDurationMs: 60 * 60_000, interventions: 50 }),
-    );
-
-    const ranked = rankByReachThenToil([singleProjectHeavy, crossProject]);
-
-    expect(ranked.map((r) => r.proposal.candidateId)).toEqual(['cross', 'single-heavy']);
-  });
-
-  it('an unpriced item never outranks a priced peer in the same reach tier', () => {
-    const unpriced = item('unpriced', 1, { frequency: 0, medianDurationMs: 0, interventions: 0, priced: false });
-    const priced = item('priced', 1, pricing({ frequency: 1, medianDurationMs: 100, interventions: 0 }));
-
-    const ranked = rankByReachThenToil([unpriced, priced]);
-
-    expect(ranked.map((r) => r.proposal.candidateId)).toEqual(['priced', 'unpriced']);
-  });
-
-  it('is pure and deterministic: re-ranking the same items, in a different starting order, yields the same order', () => {
-    const a = item('a', 1, pricing({ frequency: 4, medianDurationMs: 20_000, interventions: 1 }));
-    const b = item('b', 1, pricing({ frequency: 2, medianDurationMs: 90_000, interventions: 2 }));
-    const c = item('c', 1, pricing({ frequency: 9, medianDurationMs: 5_000, interventions: 0 }));
-
-    const rankedForward = rankByReachThenToil([a, b, c]).map((r) => r.proposal.candidateId);
-    const rankedShuffled = rankByReachThenToil([c, a, b]).map((r) => r.proposal.candidateId);
-    const rankedReverse = rankByReachThenToil([c, b, a]).map((r) => r.proposal.candidateId);

-    expect(rankedShuffled).toEqual(rankedForward);
-    expect(rankedReverse).toEqual(rankedForward);

-});
diff --git a/spikes/loop-hole/tests/toil.spec.ts b/spikes/loop-hole/tests/toil.spec.ts
